sentences.en: Bright sparks light up the night sky, resembling a rain of pretty flowers.
sentences.cn: 明亮的火花（spark）点亮夜空，看起来像（resemble）一场美丽的花雨（rain）。

sentences.en: This amazing show is called "striking iron flowers".
sentences.cn: 这场令人惊叹的（amazing）表演名为“打（strike）铁（iron）花”。

sentences.en: It's an ancient folk art in China and it has a history of over 1, o00 years!
sentences.cn: 它是一项古老的中国民间艺术，距今已有一千多年的历史！

sentences.en: It is deeply rooted in traditional Chinese culture.
sentences.cn: 它深深地（deeply）植根于中国传统的（traditional）文化。

sentences.en: Striking iron flowers is often performed during main festivals， such as the Spring Festival and the Lantern t—kids Festival.
sentences.cn: 打铁花通常在主要的节日（festival）期间上演，例如（such as）春节（the Spring Festival）和元宵节（the Lan term Festival）。

sentences.en: When the first sparks fly, cheers break out- clap their hands loudly, and elders smile, saying the sparks can “dispel bad luck".
sentences.cn: 当第一（first）簇火花飞起（fly）时，欢呼声（cheer）瞬间爆发一一孩子（kid）们大声地（loudly）鼓掌（clap），长辈（elder）们满脸笑容，说这火花能“驱散（dispel）厄运（bad luck）”。

sentences.en: The crowd is filled with excitement.
sentences.cn: 人群（crowd）充满了兴奋（excitement）。

sentences.en: The sparks glow brightly, standing for happiness and good wishes.
sentences.cn: 火花明亮地（brightly）闪耀（glow）着，象征着幸福（happiness）与美好祝愿。

sentences.en: Do you know how this craft is performed?
sentences.cn: 你知道这项手艺（craft）是怎么表演的吗？

sentences.en: It's not easy!
sentences.cn: 这可不容易（easy）！

sentences.en: First, performers put old iron into a large furnace.
sentences.cn: 首先，表演者（performer）会将废旧的铁放进一座大熔炉（fiurnace）里。

sentences.en: They put wood or coal inside to burn, and the temperature gets so high that the air around it feels like a warm wind.
sentences.cn: 他们把木头（wood）或煤（coal）放在里面（inside）燃烧，温度变得十分高以至于周围的空气（air）都热得像一阵暖（warm）风。

sentences.en: Then, they heat the iron to a very high temperature until it melts into liquid.
sentences.cn: 随后，他们把铁加热（heat）到极高的温度，直到它熔化成液体（liquid）。

sentences.en: In the final stage, they use professional tools to splash the liquid iron into the air.
sentences.cn: 在最后阶段，他们使用（use）专业的（professional）工具将铁水泼洒（splash）向空中。

sentences.en: When the liquid iron comes into contact with the cold air, it turns into lovely sparks.
sentences.cn: 当铁水接触（contact）到冷空气时，它就会变成美丽的（lovely）火花。

sentences.en: To do this, a performer needs powerful arms, great skills and lots of courage.
sentences.cn: 完成这样的表演，表演者需要有强有力的手臂（arm）、精湛的技艺和十足的勇气。

sentences.en: It shows how wise Chinese craftsmen are.
sentences.cn: 这门技艺展现了中国工匠（craftsman）是多么充满智慧（wise）。

sentences.en: Currently, more and more young people are showing great enthusiasm for this folk art, hoping to carry it forward to keep traditional Chinese culture alive.
sentences.cn: 目前（currently），越来越多的年轻人对这项民间艺术表现出了极大的热情（enthusiasm），希望（hope）将其传承下去，让中国传统文化永葆活力（alive）。

sentences.en: Thus, we should protect and pass down this precious heritage by learning the related skills.
sentences.cn: 因此（thus），我们应当通过学习相关的（related）技艺保护并传承这一珍贵的（precious）遗产（heritage）。

readings.title: HainanOpen for a New Start
readings.text: Have you heard about the special customs policy in Hainan? It aims to establish a better customs management system. This system brings real benefits to Hainan's trade and local enterprises. Take a soup seasoning factory as an example. The duty-free policy for value-added processed products enables it to save about 60million yuan inta riffs enable remarks, "Under this every year. The factory owner new policy, Hainan will connect more easily with the mainland market and the world. This helps our products reach more remote places." These benefits aren't restricted to a single business. By November 2025, the policy had helped local companies get 11.42 billion yuan in domestic sales and save 878 million yuan in tariff costs. In has addition, improved customs clearance efficiency customs officers at made trade faster. For example, Haikou Port can complete truck checks in 3 minutes. Nowadays, in the eyes of the general public, these changes are obvious. Young people in Hainan see improvements in employment, education and medical resources in their hometowns. Meanwhile, a tourist commented that this policy doesn't affect their trips and they don't need extra documents, adding they can enjoy more comfortable trips and services in Hainan. All in all, Hainan's special customs policy isn't closing the island off. Instead, it's opening up more to the world, laying a solid foundation for its high- quality development. This policy not only boosts the local economy but also strengthens Hainan's connection with the global market. Moreover, this special customs policy attracts numerous investors from home and abroad, which further promotes the upgrade of Hainan's industrial structure and helps the island establish a more open and dynamic economic pattern. These measures also attract talented individuals, fostering long-term prosperity.
readings.translation: 你听说海南的特殊海关（customs）政策（policy）了吗？它旨在建立（establish）一套更好的海关管理（management）制度（system）。这套制度能为海南的贸易（trade）和本地企业（enterprises）带来实实在在的好处（benefit）。以一家汤料调味品工厂（factory）为例。深加工增值类产品的免税（duty-free）政策使它每年能够（enable）节省约6000万（60million）元关税（tariff）。该工厂拥有者（owner）评论（remark）：“在这项新政策下，海南将更便捷地连接大陆（mainland）与国际市场。这有助于我们的产品到达更远的（remote）地方。”这些好处并非只限（restrict）于单一（single）企业。截至2025年11月（November），该政策已帮助本地公司（company）实现国内销售额（sale）114.2亿（11.42billion）元，并节省关税花费（cost）8.78亿元。此外，通关效率（customsclearanceeficiency）的提升也让贸易往来变得更加高效。例如，海口口岸（port）的海关工作人员仅需3分钟就能完成货车（truck）检查。如今，在公众眼中，这些变化显而易见。海南本地年轻人见证了家乡（hometown）在就业（employment）、教育（education）和医疗资源（resource）方面的改善（improvement）。与此同时，一位游客评论（comment），这项新政策不会影响（affect）他们的出行，他们不需要额外的文件，还补充说在海南能享受到更舒服的（comfortable）出行体验与服务（service）。总而言之，海南的特殊海关政策不是将这座岛屿封闭起来。恰恰相反，它正进一步扩大对世界的开放，为其高质量发展（development）莫定了坚实的（solid）基础（foundation）这项政策不仅促进（boost）了当地经济（economy）的发展，还加强（strengthen）了海南与全球市场的联系。此外，这一特殊的海关政策吸引（attract）了大量来自国内外（home and abroad）的投资者（investor），进一步推动了海南产业（industrial）结构（structure）的升级（upgrade），并帮助该岛建立起更加开放和充满活力的（dynamic）经济模式。这些措施还吸引了人（individual）才，促进（foster）了长期的繁荣（prosperity）。

readings.title: The Birth of Tiangong Kaiwu
readings.text: Tiangong Kaiwu is a unique book. It was written by Song Yingxing, a scholar of the Ming Dynasty. At that time, China had many intelligent craftsmen. They were skilled at farming, weaving cloth and making pottery. Song Yingxing recorded all these skills in this excellent book. Song Yingxing was born in Jiangxi Province. He studied diligently in his childhood and became an official when he grew up. However, he loved watching ordinary people work most. He traveled to many places, observing how farmers grew rice and how craftsmen smelted iron and made paper. He drew carefully and documented everything he witnessed. Eventually, he completed the great work. Its title means using the power of nature to make useful things. This concept reflects his deep respect for the harmony between humans and the natural world. Song Yingxing believed that practical knowledge was equally valuable and deserved to be recorded for future generations. Published in 1637, it is honoured as the 17th- century Chinese Encyclopedia of Handicrafts, containing vivid illustrations of ancient techniques. The book consists of eighteen sections, and each part discusses an important skill. It explains how to plant crops. For instance, farmers use oxen to plough the fields, carry water to irrigate the crops and harvest golden rice in autumn. It also introduces silkworm feed on mulberry leaves. raising. Baby silkworms When they grow up, their silk can be woven into delicate cloth. In addition, it records how to make paper, fire bricks, and even produce weapons. Later, this book gradually spread to Japan and Europe. Then, more and more people in these regions read it and acquired a lot of wonderful Chinese skills from it. It's truly a great treasure of ancient Chinese science and technology that still shines with wisdom today.
readings.translation: 《天工开物》是一本独特的（unique）书。它由明朝（dynasty）的学者宋应星所写（write）。当时，中国有许多有才智的（intelligent）工匠（craftsman）。他们擅长耕种（farm）、织（weave）布和制陶器（pottery）。宋应星将所有这些技艺（skill）都记录在这本优秀的（excellent）著作中。宋应星出生于江西省。他在童年（childhood）时期勤奋地（diligently）学习，长大后成为了一名官员。然而，他却最爱观察普通（ordinary）人劳作。他游历了许多地方，观察（observe）农民如何种植水稻以及工匠如何炼铁（iron）和造纸。他仔细地画下并记录（document）了他所目赌（witness）的一切。最终（eventually），他完成（complete）了这部伟大的作品。书名（title）意为利用自然的力量创造有用之物。这一理念（concept）反映（reflect）了他对人类与自然世界之间和谐（harmony）共存的深深敬意。宋应星认为实用的（practical）知识同样地（equally）具有价值，值得（deserve）被记录下来留给后代（generation）。该书于1637年出版，被誉为17世纪的中国手工艺（handicraft）百科全书，书中包含（contain）了展现古代技术（technique）的生动（vivid）插图（illustration）。这本书由十八个部分（section）组成（consist），每个部分都讲述了一项重要的技能。它详细介绍了如何种植作物。例如（for instance），农民们会用牛（ox）犁（plough）地、挑水灌溉（irrigate）庄稼，并在秋天（autumn）收获（harvest）金黄的（golden）稻谷。书中还介绍（introduce）了养蚕（silkworm）之术。幼蚕以桑叶为食（fee don）。当它们长大后，其丝可以被织成精美的（delicate）布料。此外（in addition），书中还记录了如何造纸、烧制砖块（brick），甚至制造兵器（weapon）的方法。后来，这本著作慢慢流传至日本和欧洲。随后，越来越多这些地区的人阅读了这本书，并从中获得（acquire）了许多精妙的（wonder fi ul）中国技艺。它确实是中国古代科学（science）技术的瑰宝（treasure），至今仍闪耀（shine）着智慧的光芒。

readings.title: Craftsmanship of Qingxu Vinegar
readings.text: Vinegar is always a must in the dining tradition of Shanxi people. Many Shanxi families never sit down to have dinner without a bottle of vinegar on the table. Put vinegar in cold and raw dishes to boost your appetite. Dip dumplings in it, and the greasiness of meat will decrease. Pour a spoon of it when you cook. It will make the meat easy to chew, enrich the soup and bring great satisfaction to taste buds. This special sour flavour comes from Qingxu, the birthplace of Shanxi vinegar. Qingxu boasts a long history of vinegar brewing. According to legend, the ancient ruler Emperor Yao made “bitter wine"the original name of vinegar in Qingxu long ago. Over successive centuries, the way of making vinegar developed gradually. In the Qing Dynasty, vinegar makers added smoking process and aging steps. They dried the vinegar in the sun in summer and removed the ice from it in winter. Many trainees came to learn the craft. They did not let any error discourage them. In 2006, this craft was listed as a national intangible cultural heritage. Making vinegar is not an easy task. A gifted chef once said, “Caution is the soul of this craft." It starts with high-quality grains. After being crushed into four to six pieces, each grain goes through five key steps. During the process, craftsmen stir the grains to keep the temperature below 35°C. This prevents the grains from going bad. With a special pot, the process of smoking turns the grains purple and adds a rich smell. Finally, craftsmen store the vinegar in jars for at least one year to achieve its perfect taste. They work with caution and without complaint. Today, operators use electronic systems to check the production process. Qingxu vinegar shows the brilliant combination of primitive crafts and modern technology. It is a gift from history.
readings.translation: 醋（vinegar）在山西人的饮食传统（tradition）中总是必不可少的（must）。很多山西家庭吃饭（dinner）时，餐桌上从来都少不了一瓶（a bottle of）醋。把醋加进生冷菜（col dan draw dish）里，可以增进（boost）你的食欲（appetite）。饺子蘸（dip）一下醋，肉（meat）的油腻（greasiness）感就会减少（decrease）。做饭时倒（pour）一勺醋。它能让肉更容易咀嚼（chew），丰富（enrich）汤（soup）的味道，给味蕾（taste bud）带来极大的满足（satisfaction）。这种特别的酸（sour）味（flavour）来自清徐—山西醋的发源地（birthplace）。清徐拥有（boast）悠久的酿（brewing）醋历史。根据（according to）传说，古代君主（ruler）尧帝很久以前制作出了“苦（bitter）酒（wine）”一这是清徐醋原来的（original）名字。在接下来的（successive）几个世纪里，制醋的方法逐渐发展。在清朝，制醋者（maker）增加了烟熏（smoking）和陈酿这两道工序。他们夏天把醋放在太阳下晾晒，冬天除去（remove）里面的冰。很多学徒（trainee）来学习这门手艺。他们不会因为任何错误（error）而灰心（discourage）。2006年，这门技艺被列入国家级非物质文化遗产（intangible cultural heritage）名录。制醋不是一件容易的事。一位有天赋的（gifted）主厨（chef）曾说：“谨慎（caution）是这门手艺的灵魂（soul）。”它首先从优质的谷物开始。每粒谷物被压（crush）成4至6块后，要经历五个关键步骤。在这个过程中，匠人（craftsman）会搅拌（stir）谷物，使温度保持在35摄氏度以下。这样可以避免谷物变质。通过一个特制的锅（pot），熏制的过程会让谷物变成紫色（purple），并增添浓郁的香气。最后，匠人会把醋存放在罐子（jar）里至少一年，以达到完美的口感。他们工作谨慎，毫无抱怨（complaint）。如今，操作人员（operator）使用电子（electronic）系统来检查生产过程。清徐醋展现了原始的（primitive）工艺与现代技术的巧妙（brilliant）结合。它是一份来自历史的礼物（gift）。

sentences.en: Vinegar is always a must in the dining tradition of Shanxi people.
sentences.cn: 醋（vinegar）在山西人的饮食传统（tradition）中总是必不可少的（must）。

sentences.en: Many Shanxi families never sit down to have dinner without a bottle of vinegar on the table.
sentences.cn: 很多山西家庭吃饭（dinner）时，餐桌上从来都少不了一瓶（a bottle of）醋。

sentences.en: Put vinegar in cold and raw dishes to boost your appetite.
sentences.cn: 把醋加进生冷菜（col dan draw dish）里，可以增进（boost）你的食欲（appetite）。

sentences.en: Dip dumplings in it, and the greasiness of meat will decrease.
sentences.cn: 饺子蘸（dip）一下醋，肉（meat）的油腻（greasiness）感就会减少（decrease）。

sentences.en: Pour a spoon of it when you cook.
sentences.cn: 做饭时倒（pour）一勺醋。

sentences.en: It will make the meat easy to chew, enrich the soup and bring great satisfaction to taste buds.
sentences.cn: 它能让肉更容易咀嚼（chew），丰富（enrich）汤（soup）的味道，给味蕾（taste bud）带来极大的满足（satisfaction）。

sentences.en: This special sour flavour comes from Qingxu, the birthplace of Shanxi vinegar.
sentences.cn: 这种特别的酸（sour）味（flavour）来自清徐—山西醋的发源地（birthplace）。

sentences.en: Qingxu boasts a long history of vinegar brewing.
sentences.cn: 清徐拥有（boast）悠久的酿（brewing）醋历史。

sentences.en: According to legend, the ancient ruler Emperor Yao made “bitter wine"the original name of vinegar in Qingxu long ago.
sentences.cn: 根据（according to）传说，古代君主（ruler）尧帝很久以前制作出了“苦（bitter）酒（wine）”一这是清徐醋原来的（original）名字。

sentences.en: Over successive centuries, the way of making vinegar developed gradually.
sentences.cn: 在接下来的（successive）几个世纪里，制醋的方法逐渐发展。

sentences.en: In the Qing Dynasty, vinegar makers added smoking process and aging steps.
sentences.cn: 在清朝，制醋者（maker）增加了烟熏（smoking）和陈酿这两道工序。

sentences.en: They dried the vinegar in the sun in summer and removed the ice from it in winter.
sentences.cn: 他们夏天把醋放在太阳下晾晒，冬天除去（remove）里面的冰。

sentences.en: Many trainees came to learn the craft.
sentences.cn: 很多学徒（trainee）来学习这门手艺。

sentences.en: They did not let any error discourage them.
sentences.cn: 他们不会因为任何错误（error）而灰心（discourage）。

sentences.en: In 2006, this craft was listed as a national intangible cultural heritage.
sentences.cn: 2006年，这门技艺被列入国家级非物质文化遗产（intangible cultural heritage）名录。

sentences.en: Making vinegar is not an easy task.
sentences.cn: 制醋不是一件容易的事。

sentences.en: A gifted chef once said, “Caution is the soul of this craft." It starts with high-quality grains.
sentences.cn: 一位有天赋的（gifted）主厨（chef）曾说：“谨慎（caution）是这门手艺的灵魂（soul）。”

sentences.en: After being crushed into four to six pieces, each grain goes through five key steps.
sentences.cn: 它首先从优质的谷物开始。每粒谷物被压（crush）成4至6块后，要经历五个关键步骤。

sentences.en: During the process, craftsmen stir the grains to keep the temperature below 35°C.
sentences.cn: 在这个过程中，匠人（craftsman）会搅拌（stir）谷物，使温度保持在35摄氏度以下。

sentences.en: This prevents the grains from going bad.
sentences.cn: 这样可以避免谷物变质。

sentences.en: With a special pot, the process of smoking turns the grains purple and adds a rich smell.
sentences.cn: 通过一个特制的锅（pot），熏制的过程会让谷物变成紫色（purple），并增添浓郁的香气。

sentences.en: Finally, craftsmen store the vinegar in jars for at least one year to achieve its perfect taste.
sentences.cn: 最后，匠人会把醋存放在罐子（jar）里至少一年，以达到完美的口感。

sentences.en: They work with caution and without complaint.
sentences.cn: 他们工作谨慎，毫无抱怨（complaint）。

sentences.en: Today, operators use electronic systems to check the production process.
sentences.cn: 如今，操作人员（operator）使用电子（electronic）系统来检查生产过程。

sentences.en: Qingxu vinegar shows the brilliant combination of primitive crafts and modern technology.
sentences.cn: 清徐醋展现了原始的（primitive）工艺与现代技术的巧妙（brilliant）结合。

sentences.en: It is a gift from history.
sentences.cn: 它是一份来自历史的礼物（gift）。

readings.title: Wang Hong-a Rising Maths Star
readings.titleCn: 王红——冉冉升起的数学之星
readings.text: Last June, 34-year-old mathematician Wang Hong gave a series of lectures at Peking University. The lecture hall was packed beyond capacity, with people standing in every available space, even spilling into the hallways. Many leading mathematicians came specially to hear her lectures. Among those seated in the front row was Wei Dongyi, a well-known researcher at Peking University, who attended all three days of the talks. Born in 1991 in a small town in Guilin, Guangxi, Wang Hong showed an extraordinary talent for self-study from a young age. She mastered first-grade knowledge by age five and directly skipped to second grade. At just 16, she was admitted to Peking University, initially studying geophysics before transferring to mathematics. After earning her bachelor's degree in 201l, she pursued further study in France and the United States, receiving her Ph. D. from MIT in 2019 under the supervision of Professor Larry Guth. In early 2025, Wang Hong and Joshua Zahl, a mathematician at the University of British Columbia, jointly published a 127-page paper that shook the global mathematical world. They successfully proved the three-dimensional Kakeya set conjecture, a problem that had puzzled mathematicians for over a century. The breakthrough was widely praised by leading figures, including Fields Medalist Terence Tao. Later that year, Wang was awarded both the Salem Prize and the Ostrowski Prize, two prestigious honours often seen as predictors of future Fields Medal winners. In September of the same year, she became a permanent professor at the Institut des Hautes Etudes Scientifiques (IHES) in France, a position held by some of history's greatest mathematicians. Many experts now predict that Wang Hong is likely to win the next Fields Medal, the highest honour in mathematics, which would make her the first Chinese woman to receive this award. However, in the face of all the praise, Wang remains humble and says that no one is born a genius and she just focuses more on mathematics. Her journey of struggle inspires countless young mathematicians worldwide.
readings.translation: 去年六月，34岁的数学家王虹在北京大学（university）开展了一系列（a series of）讲座（lecture）。报告厅挤（pack）满了人，超出（beyond）了它的容量（capacity），每个可用的（available）空间（space）都站满了人，人群甚至涌到（spill）了走廊（hallway）。许多一流的（leading）数学家专程前来聆听她的讲座。前（front）排（row）落座（seat）的人当中（among）有一位是北京大学的知名研究员韦东奕，他全程听完了为期三天的讲座。王虹1991年出生于（born）广西桂林的一个小镇，她自幼便展现出非凡的（extraordinary）自学天赋（talent）。她五岁就掌握（master）了一年级的知识（knowledge），并直接（directly）跳级到（skip to）二年级。年仅16岁时，她便被北京大学录取（be admitted to），最初（initially）学习地球物理学，后来转入数学（mathematics）专业。2011年获得（earn）学士学位后，她前往法国和美国继续（pursue）深造，并于2019年在拉里·古斯教授的指导下获得麻省理工学院博士学位。2025年初，王虹与不列颠哥伦比亚大学的数学家约书亚·扎尔联合（jointly）发表了一篇长达127页的论文，震惊（shake）了全球数学界。他们成功地（successfully）证明（prove）了三维挂谷猜想，一个困扰（puzzle）数学家们一个多世纪（century）的问题。这一突破（breakthrough）受到了包括菲尔兹奖得主陶哲轩在内的一流人士（figure）的广泛（widely）赞扬（praise）同年晚些时候，王虹被授予（award）塞勒姆奖（prize）和奥斯特洛夫斯基奖，这两项有威望的荣誉（honour）历来被视为未来菲尔兹奖（medal）得主（winner）的先兆。同年九月，她成为（become）法国高等科学研究所的终身（permanent）教授，该职位（position）曾由历史上一些最伟大的数学家担任（hold）。许多专家现在预言（predict），王虹很可能（likely）赢得下一届菲尔兹奖，这是数学（领域）的最高荣誉，这将使她成为首位获此奖项的中国女性。然而，面对所有赞誉，王虹依然保持（remain）谦逊（humble）。她表示没有人天生就是天才，她只是更专注于数学。她的拼搏历程（journey）激励着世界各地（worldwide）无数（countless）年轻数学家。

sentences.en: The breakthrough was widely praised by leading figures, including Fields Medalist Terence Tao. Later that year, Wang was awarded both the Salem Prize and the Ostrowski Prize, two prestigious honours often seen as predictors of future Fields Medal winners.

readings.title: Why We Eat Laba Porridge?
readings.text: Laba Festival falls on the eighth day of the twelfth lunar month. On this day, people usually eat laba porridge. But why do we consume this particular porridge on this day? There is a wonderful folk tale about it. Zhu Yuanzhang, the founding emperor of the Ming Dynasty, was very poor when he was young. To earn his living, he had to do many different kinds of jobs, such as working as a cowherd. One winter day, he was cold and hungry. By accident, he found some grains in a mouse hole. There were red beans, rice, dates and peanuts. He collected them, cleaned them and cooked them into hot porridge. At that moment, the porridge was the most delicious cuisine he had ever tasted. Years later, he became an emperor and could eat all kinds of delicious food. Nevertheless, on one cold day, he thought of that plain porridge, which once rescued his life. So he commanded the royal kitchen to cook similar porridge with many grains and nuts, and called it laba porridge. Eating the porridge, he thought of all the tough days he had endured in the past. Hence, he distributed it to his ministers, hoping they would also bear in mind ordinary human beings hard life. Soon, average citizens also cooked laba porridge on this day, and it became a traditional custom. Today, the porridge still reminds us to cherish food and be content with what we have, so we can find lasting joy. It carries people's sincere aspirations for a better life, serving as a bridge linking modern people with ancient traditions. Laba porridge symbolizes the harmony among diverse ingredients, reflecting the ancient philosophy that unity can create something precious out of ordinary elements. In a modern society characterized by fast pace and instant gratification, the slow process of preparing the porridge reminds us to value patience and perseverance.
readings.translation: 腊八节在农历的（lunar）第十二（twelfth）个月的第八（eighth）天。这一天，人们通常会喝腊八粥（porridge）。但是为什么我们要在这一天喝（consume）这种特别的（particular）粥呢？这里有一个关于它的精彩的民间故事（tale）。明朝开国皇帝（founding emperor）朱元璋年轻时非常贫穷。为了谋生（earn his living），他不得不从事各种各样的工作，比如当牧童（cowherd）。一个冬日，他又冷又饿（hungry）。偶然地（by accident），他在一个老鼠（mouse）洞里发现了一些谷物（grain）。有红豆（bean）、大米、枣（date）和花生（peanut）。他把这些收集（collect）起来，清洗千净并煮（cook）成了热粥。那一刻，这粥是他有史以来（ever）品尝（taste）过的最美味的佳肴（cuisine）。多年以后，他成为了皇帝，能够吃到各种美味的食物。然而（nevertheless），在一个寒冷的日子里，他想起了那碗曾经（once）救（rescue）过他命的简单的（plain）粥。于是，他命令（command）皇家的（royal）厨房（kitchen）用许多谷物和坚果（nut）煮出类似的（similar）粥，并称之为腊八粥。喝着这粥，他想起了过去熬（endure）过的那些艰苦的（tough）日子。因此（hence），他将粥分发（distribute）给了他的大臣们（minister），希望他们也能将普通人（human being）的艰苦生活牢记在心（bear in mind）。不久（soon），普通百姓（citizen）也在这一天煮腊八粥，这变成了一项传统习俗。如今，这碗粥依然提醒着我们要珍惜粮食、知足常乐，这样我们才能找到持久的（lasting）快乐。它承载着人们对更美好生活的真诚的（sincere）期盼（aspiration），成为连接（link）现代人与古老传统的桥梁。腊八粥象征（symbolize）着各种原料（ingredient）之间的和谐，反映出“普通元素（element）皆可因统一（unity）而成就非凡事物”的古老的哲理（philosophy）。在以快节奏（fast pace）、即刻的（instant）满足为特点的现代社会中，熬制腊八粥这一缓慢的过程（process）提醒我们要重视耐心和毅力。

sentences.en: Laba Festival falls on the eighth day of the twelfth lunar month.
sentences.cn: 腊八节在农历的（lunar）第十二（twelfth）个月的第八（eighth）天。

sentences.en: On this day, people usually eat laba porridge.
sentences.cn: 这一天，人们通常会喝腊八粥（porridge）。

sentences.en: But why do we consume this particular porridge on this day?
sentences.cn: 但是为什么我们要在这一天喝（consume）这种特别的（particular）粥呢？

sentences.en: There is a wonderful folk tale about it.
sentences.cn: 这里有一个关于它的精彩的民间故事（tale）。

sentences.en: Zhu Yuanzhang, the founding emperor of the Ming Dynasty, was very poor when he was young.
sentences.cn: 明朝开国皇帝（founding emperor）朱元璋年轻时非常贫穷。

sentences.en: To earn his living, he had to do many different kinds of jobs, such as working as a cowherd.
sentences.cn: 为了谋生（earn his living），他不得不从事各种各样的工作，比如当牧童（cowherd）。

sentences.en: One winter day, he was cold and hungry.
sentences.cn: 一个冬日，他又冷又饿（hungry）。

sentences.en: By accident, he found some grains in a mouse hole.
sentences.cn: 偶然地（by accident），他在一个老鼠（mouse）洞里发现了一些谷物（grain）。

sentences.en: There were red beans, rice, dates and peanuts.
sentences.cn: 有红豆（bean）、大米、枣（date）和花生（peanut）。

sentences.en: He collected them, cleaned them and cooked them into hot porridge.
sentences.cn: 他把这些收集（collect）起来，清洗千净并煮（cook）成了热粥。

sentences.en: At that moment, the porridge was the most delicious cuisine he had ever tasted.
sentences.cn: 那一刻，这粥是他有史以来（ever）品尝（taste）过的最美味的佳肴（cuisine）。

sentences.en: Years later, he became an emperor and could eat all kinds of delicious food.
sentences.cn: 多年以后，他成为了皇帝，能够吃到各种美味的食物。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, on one cold day, he thought of that plain porridge, which once rescued his life.
sentences.cn: 然而（nevertheless），在一个寒冷的日子里，他想起了那碗曾经（once）救（rescue）过他命的简单的（plain）粥。

sentences.en: So he commanded the royal kitchen to cook similar porridge with many grains and nuts, and called it laba porridge.
sentences.cn: 于是，他命令（command）皇家的（royal）厨房（kitchen）用许多谷物和坚果（nut）煮出类似的（similar）粥，并称之为腊八粥。

sentences.en: Eating the porridge, he thought of all the tough days he had endured in the past.
sentences.cn: 喝着这粥，他想起了过去熬（endure）过的那些艰苦的（tough）日子。

sentences.en: Hence, he distributed it to his ministers, hoping they would also bear in mind ordinary human beings hard life.
sentences.cn: 因此（hence），他将粥分发（distribute）给了他的大臣们（minister），希望他们也能将普通人（human being）的艰苦生活牢记在心（bear in mind）。

sentences.en: Soon, average citizens also cooked laba porridge on this day, and it became a traditional custom.
sentences.cn: 不久（soon），普通百姓（citizen）也在这一天煮腊八粥，这变成了一项传统习俗。

sentences.en: Today, the porridge still reminds us to cherish food and be content with what we have, so we can find lasting joy.
sentences.cn: 如今，这碗粥依然提醒着我们要珍惜粮食、知足常乐，这样我们才能找到持久的（lasting）快乐。

sentences.en: It carries people's sincere aspirations for a better life, serving as a bridge linking modern people with ancient traditions.
sentences.cn: 它承载着人们对更美好生活的真诚的（sincere）期盼（aspiration），成为连接（link）现代人与古老传统的桥梁。

sentences.en: Laba porridge symbolizes the harmony among diverse ingredients, reflecting the ancient philosophy that unity can create something precious out of ordinary elements.
sentences.cn: 腊八粥象征（symbolize）着各种原料（ingredient）之间的和谐，反映出“普通元素（element）皆可因统一（unity）而成就非凡事物”的古老的哲理（philosophy）。

sentences.en: In a modern society characterized by fast pace and instant gratification, the slow process of preparing the porridge reminds us to value patience and perseverance.
sentences.cn: 在以快节奏（fast pace）、即刻的（instant）满足为特点的现代社会中，熬制腊八粥这一缓慢的过程（process）提醒我们要重视耐心和毅力。

readings.title: My Journey with Tai Chi
readings.text: I first encountered Tai Chi in Ottawa's Chinatown. Men and women gathered in loose formation a square. Their classical movements blended into a meditative dance. I was deeply impressed by its beauty and grace. It was like watching a water lily opening. Yet I couldn't see the point. I could achieve my fitness goals from exercise classes, swimming and cycling-and moving so slowly didn't seem to build muscle, my objective for all activities. I chose only to admire this martial art but kept my distance. Afterwards, my physician recommended that I join a training group. It was for Tai Chi beginners, led by a caring and patient instructor. I had thought that my goal would be to master the 108 moves. Technically right, but false on so many counts. The class was full of elegant people who glided effortlessly, seemingly never confused about where to move next. They comforted me that they had been beginners once too, and it was probable that I would be able to remember all the moves within three or four years. Three to four years! Graduate degrees took less time. I knew they were right, so I made a decision. Commit and improve. That was my only path. Anotherrealization came to me when I attended an advanced class. We began with fundamental exercises, and almost immediately, the instructor singled me out for guidance. To be singled out was a great privilege, but I was very embarrassed. All the others in the class paused and turned to watch me while the instructor corrected my positioning. “Don't bend your waist," he said, and I was unable to repeat the movement. “Straighten your back," he urged, and this continued-perhaps for only a few minutes, but it seemed like endless hours. I couldn't say, “Yeah, I comprehend it." I had to show that I did. I concentrated as I had never done before, listening to whatever the instructor was saying, watching his movements and then willing my body to move in imitation. I was unlearning and learning, overcoming awkwardness to focus. Certainly, I realized that I was embracing a new way of being in the world-truly listening and open to correction. I was uncertain whether I would ever master the 1o8 moves. What I did know is that I had found a pleasant activity in my life where transformation and growth are not just possible but expected, even when my stubborn personality tendencies re-emerge at every turn. Gradually, I became that lily unfolding, awoken not by sunlight and warmth but by this mild martial art. hanfu Beijing Opera Shadow puppetry 24 solar terms Folk culture Arts Chinese ink painting Chinese tea culture Paper-cutting the Spring Festival Chinese knotting Handicrafts the Dragon Boat Festival Festivals Chinese porcelain the Mid-Autumn Festival
readings.translation: 我第一次逅（encounter）太极拳是在渥太华的唐人街。男女老少以松散的（loose）队形（formation）聚集（gather）在广场（square）上。他们古典的（classical）动作融汇成了一种实想式的舞蹈。它的美和优雅（grace）给我留下了深刻印象（impress）。就像看着一朵睡莲缓缓绽放。然而（yet），那时我看不出这项运动的意义。我可以通过健身课、游泳和骑自行车（cycling）达成我的健康（fitness）目标（goal），而这么慢的动作似乎无法练出肌肉（muscle），这可是我所有活动的目的（objective）。我只选择（choose）远远欣赏这种武术（martial art）。后来（afterwards），我的医生（physician）推荐（recommend）我加入一个训练小组。这是为太极拳初学者（beginner）开设的，由一位乐于助人（caring）且有耐心的（patient）教练（instructor）带领。我原以为我的目标是掌握108式。从技艺上（technically）讲是正确的，但有很多方面都是错误的（false）。班上满是优雅的（elegant）人，他们滑行（glide）得毫不费力，似乎永远不会对接下来该往哪里移动而感到困惑（confused）。他们安慰（comfort）我说，他们也曾是初学者，我在三四年之内记住（remember）所有的动作是很有可能的（probable）。三四年！读个研究生都只用更少的（less）时间。我知道（know）他们是对的，于是我下定决心（decision）。全心全意投入（commit）并不断改进（improve）。这是我唯一的出路。当我参加（attend）了一个高阶班时，我又有了新的领悟（realization）。我们从基础（fundamental）动作开始，教练很练在纠正我的走位（positioning）时，班上的其他人都停（pause）了下来，转过头来看着我。“别弯（bend）腰（waist）。教练说，而我却不能够（unable）重复这个动作。“挺直后背。”他不停叮竭，就这样持续着一一也许（perhaps）只有几分钟，但看起来像无止境的（endless）数个小时（hour）。我不能嘴上说着“是的，我理解（comprehend）了”，我得表现出来。我前所未有地聚精会神（concentrate），听（listen）教练说的任何（whatever）一句话，观察他的动作，然后想要（will）带动自己的身体去模仿（imitation）。我在忘却与学习中，克服别扭感，集中注意力。当然（certainly），我意识到自己正在拥抱（embrace）一种全新的生活方式一一真正地倾听，坦然接受纠正（correction）。我曾不确定（uncertain）自已是否能掌握这108式。我所清楚的是，在我的生活中，我找到了一项令人愉悦的（pleasant)活动，在这里，变化（transformation）与成长不仅有可能（possible），而且是理所当然的，即便我那固执的（stubborn）本性（personality tendency）总是不断地出现。渐渐地，我已化作那朵绽放的睡莲，不是被阳光（sunlight）和温暖（warmth）而唤醒（awake），而是因这温和的（mild）武术而绽放。

readings.title: SBTI
readings.text: SBTI Takes the Internet by Storm A humorous personality quiz known as “SBTI" has recently taken Chinese social media by storm. Many users are sharing their results with self-mocking humour and Internet slang. While the format mirrors the well-known Myers-Briggs Type Indicator (MBTI), SBTI is actually a light-hearted online joke full of irony and contemporary Internet language. On April 9, searches for “SBTI" reached over 40 million on a platform, and discussions reportedly exceeded 20 million across various social platforms Much of the quiz's appeal comes from its name, which is bold and immediately catches people's attention with its humour. Like the MBTI, SBTI asks users a series of questions and gives them a four-letter personality label for social sharing. However, SBTI departs from the relatively rigorous psychological categories of the MBTI. Instead, it offers descriptions that act more like online trends or exaggerated images of Internet life. It uses the typical familiar structure of personality tests but throws away the seriousness, making it a social joke rather than a real self-discovery tool. This explains why young people love SBTI. It doesn't try to give deep psychological insights or define a user's long-term identity. Instead, it captures and offers a quick snapshot of a person's current mood. Users post their results not as a serious way to judge themselves, but as a casual comment on their current feelings. In this context, the appeal is found in social recognition rather than scientific accuracy. Consequently, SBTI behaves more like a viral trend than a formal personality framework. It has turned from personal intervention into a digital phenomenon. The quiz was created by an online content creator. She mentioned that it was just for fun and that she wasn't a psychology expert. She made it clear that this project was intended only for entertainment purposes. The original idea was to persuade a friend to drink original personality type. She stressed that she hasn't received professional psychology training and pointed out that the current version of the quiz was just an early one. Despite starting out in such a simple way, the quiz became a huge hit. Its success lies in its low- pressure nature-it borrows the form of MBTI to give users a funny and easy way to express their current online mood. After all, it's fine to laugh at ourselves and share a joke online. But real confidence comes from accepting who we are without needing external tags. Whether the outcome is funny any or strange, our value is decided by our efforts, our curiosity, our passion, and our persistence not by a four-letter code on a screen. -tion
readings.translation: 一个被称为“SBTI”的幽默（humorous）性格（personality）测试最近（recently）在中国社交媒体上迅速风靡（take...by storm）。许多用户（user）正用自嘲式的（self-mocking）幽默（humour）和网络俚语（Internet slang）分享自己的测试结果。尽管其形式（format）效仿了著名的迈尔斯－布里格斯性格分类指标（MBTI），但SBTI实际上是一个充满了讽刺（irony）和当代（contemporary）网络语言的轻松的（light-hearted）网络玩笑。四月（April）9日，“SBTI”在一个平台（platform）上的搜索（search）量超过了4000万，据报道，其在各大社交平台上的讨论（discussion）量也超过（exceed）了2000万。这个测试的吸引力（appeal）大多（much）来自它的名字，这个名字大胆（bold）并且能立刻（immediately）以其幽默感吸引人们的注意。和MBTI一样，SBTI也会向用户提出一系列问题，并给（give）他们一个由四个字母组成的人格标签（label）供他们在社交图分享。然而，SBTI与MBTI相对（relatively）严谨的（rigorous）心理学的（psychological）分类（category）截然不同（depart）。相反，它提供的描述（description）更像是网络潮流或典型的（typical）、夸张的（exaggerated）网络生活形象。它使用了人们熟悉的性格测试框架，却摒弃了（throwaway）严肃性，使其成为一个社交玩笑，而不是真正的自我探索工具。这就解释了为什么年轻人喜欢SBTI。它并不试图提供深刻的心理洞察（insight）或是定义（define）用户的长期特征（identity）。相反，它只捕捉（capture）并提供一个人当前（current）情绪的简要概括。用户发布自己的测试结果，并不是把它当作一种严肃的自我评判（judge）方式，而是作为对当前感受的非正式评论（comment）。在这种情况下，它的吸引力来自于社交认同（recognition），而非科学准确性。因此（consequently），SBTI的行为更像是一种快速传播的（viral）趋势，而不是一个正式的人格测试框架（framework）。它已经从个人千预（intervention）转变成了一种数字现象（phenomenon）。这个测试是由一位网络的内容创作者（creator）制作的。她提到（mention）这只是为了好玩，而且她并不是心理学专家（expert）。她明确表示这个项目仅打算（intend）用于娱乐（entertainment）目的。起初的（original）想法（idea）是为了说服（persuade）一位朋友少喝酒（alcohol）一一当时甚至还有一种隐藏的“酒鬼”人格类型。她强调自己从没有接受过专业的心理学训练，并且她指出当前版本（version）的测试仅仅是一个早期版本。尽管起源如此简单，这个测试还是成了爆款（a huge hit）。它的成功在于其无压力的特征一一它借用（borrow）了MBTI的形式，为用户提供一种有趣又简单的方式来表达自已当前的网络心情。毕竞，在网上自（ourselves）嘲一下、分享个笑话是可接受的（fine）。但真正的自信（confidence）来自于接受我们本来的样子，不需要任何外部的（external）标签（tag）。无论结果（outcome）是搞笑的还是奇怪的（strange），我们的价值取决（be decided by）于我们的努力、好奇心（curiosity）、热情和毅力（persistence）一而不是屏幕上的一个四字母代码（code）。

sentences.en: SBTI Takes the Internet by Storm A humorous personality quiz known as “SBTI" has recently taken Chinese social media by storm.
sentences.cn: 一个被称为“SBTI”的幽默（humorous）性格（personality）测试最近（recently）在中国社交媒体上迅速风靡（take...by storm）。

sentences.en: Many users are sharing their results with self-mocking humour and Internet slang.
sentences.cn: 许多用户（user）正用自嘲式的（self-mocking）幽默（humour）和网络俚语（Internet slang）分享自己的测试结果。

sentences.en: While the format mirrors the well-known Myers-Briggs Type Indicator (MBTI), SBTI is actually a light-hearted online joke full of irony and contemporary Internet language.
sentences.cn: 尽管其形式（format）效仿了著名的迈尔斯－布里格斯性格分类指标（MBTI），但SBTI实际上是一个充满了讽刺（irony）和当代（contemporary）网络语言的轻松的（light-hearted）网络玩笑。

sentences.en: On April 9, searches for “SBTI" reached over 40 million on a platform, and discussions reportedly exceeded 20 million across various social platforms Much of the quiz's appeal comes from its name, which is bold and immediately catches people's attention with its humour.
sentences.cn: 四月（April）9日，“SBTI”在一个平台（platform）上的搜索（search）量超过了4000万，据报道，其在各大社交平台上的讨论（discussion）量也超过（exceed）了2000万。这个测试的吸引力（appeal）大多（much）来自它的名字，这个名字大胆（bold）并且能立刻（immediately）以其幽默感吸引人们的注意。

sentences.en: Like the MBTI, SBTI asks users a series of questions and gives them a four-letter personality label for social sharing.
sentences.cn: 和MBTI一样，SBTI也会向用户提出一系列问题，并给（give）他们一个由四个字母组成的人格标签（label）供他们在社交图分享。

sentences.en: However, SBTI departs from the relatively rigorous psychological categories of the MBTI.
sentences.cn: 然而，SBTI与MBTI相对（relatively）严谨的（rigorous）心理学的（psychological）分类（category）截然不同（depart）。

sentences.en: Instead, it offers descriptions that act more like online trends or exaggerated images of Internet life. It uses the typical familiar structure of personality tests but throws away the seriousness, making it a social joke rather than a real self-discovery tool.
sentences.cn: 相反，它提供的描述（description）更像是网络潮流或典型的（typical）、夸张的（exaggerated）网络生活形象。

sentences.en: This explains why young people love SBTI.
sentences.cn: 它使用了人们熟悉的性格测试框架，却摒弃了（throwaway）严肃性，使其成为一个社交玩笑，而不是真正的自我探索工具。

sentences.en: It doesn't try to give deep psychological insights or define a user's long-term identity.
sentences.cn: 这就解释了为什么年轻人喜欢SBTI。它并不试图提供深刻的心理洞察（insight）或是定义（define）用户的长期特征（identity）。

sentences.en: Instead, it captures and offers a quick snapshot of a person's current mood.
sentences.cn: 相反，它只捕捉（capture）并提供一个人当前（current）情绪的简要概括。

sentences.en: Users post their results not as a serious way to judge themselves, but as a casual comment on their current feelings.
sentences.cn: 用户发布自己的测试结果，并不是把它当作一种严肃的自我评判（judge）方式，而是作为对当前感受的非正式评论（comment）。

sentences.en: In this context, the appeal is found in social recognition rather than scientific accuracy.
sentences.cn: 在这种情况下，它的吸引力来自于社交认同（recognition），而非科学准确性。

sentences.en: Consequently, SBTI behaves more like a viral trend than a formal personality framework.
sentences.cn: 因此（consequently），SBTI的行为更像是一种快速传播的（viral）趋势，而不是一个正式的人格测试框架（framework）。

sentences.en: It has turned from personal intervention into a digital phenomenon.
sentences.cn: 它已经从个人千预（intervention）转变成了一种数字现象（phenomenon）。

sentences.en: The quiz was created by an online content creator.
sentences.cn: 这个测试是由一位网络的内容创作者（creator）制作的。

sentences.en: She mentioned that it was just for fun and that she wasn't a psychology expert.
sentences.cn: 她提到（mention）这只是为了好玩，而且她并不是心理学专家（expert）。

sentences.en: She made it clear that this project was intended only for entertainment purposes.
sentences.cn: 她明确表示这个项目仅打算（intend）用于娱乐（entertainment）目的。

sentences.en: The original idea was to persuade a friend to drink original personality type.
sentences.cn: 起初的（original）想法（idea）是为了说服（persuade）一位朋友少喝酒（alcohol）一一当时甚至还有一种隐藏的“酒鬼”人格类型。

sentences.en: She stressed that she hasn't received professional psychology training and pointed out that the current version of the quiz was just an early one.
sentences.cn: 她强调自己从没有接受过专业的心理学训练，并且她指出当前版本（version）的测试仅仅是一个早期版本。

sentences.en: Despite starting out in such a simple way, the quiz became a huge hit.
sentences.cn: 尽管起源如此简单，这个测试还是成了爆款（a huge hit）。

sentences.en: Its success lies in its low- pressure nature-it borrows the form of MBTI to give users a funny and easy way to express their current online mood.
sentences.cn: 它的成功在于其无压力的特征一一它借用（borrow）了MBTI的形式，为用户提供一种有趣又简单的方式来表达自已当前的网络心情。

sentences.en: After all, it's fine to laugh at ourselves and share a joke online.
sentences.cn: 毕竞，在网上自（ourselves）嘲一下、分享个笑话是可接受的（fine）。

sentences.en: But real confidence comes from accepting who we are without needing external tags.
sentences.cn: 但真正的自信（confidence）来自于接受我们本来的样子，不需要任何外部的（external）标签（tag）。

sentences.en: Whether the outcome is funny any or strange, our value is decided by our efforts, our curiosity, our passion, and our persistence not by a four-letter code on a screen.
sentences.cn: 无论结果（outcome）是搞笑的还是奇怪的（strange），我们的价值取决（be decided by）于我们的努力、好奇心（curiosity）、热情和毅力（persistence）一而不是屏幕上的一个四字母代码（code）。

readings.title: Two Ways to Stay Connected
readings.text: In the past, direct face-to-face communication was the primary way for people to interact. When trying to reach someone at a distance, one had no choice but to wait patiently for days as letters made their slow journey. However, thanks to technological advancements, we now have access to phones, emails, and video calls. These modern tools enable us to instantly connect with family and friends, whether they are nearby or on the other side of the globe, eliminating the need for anxious waiting and making communication easier and more affordable. Face-to-face conversations offer the unique advantage of direct personal interaction, including spoken words, body language, and facial expressions. Research indicates that 93% of daily face-to-face exchanges rely on body language. When words alone fail to convey meaning clearly, body language helps to build trust and strengthen emotional bonds. For instance, a hug lets us grasp someone's true emotions, deepening the connection between us. But if people are far apart or busy, phones and emails can help. We can call a faraway friend to talk or email someone we miss late at night. Phone conversations vary depending on whom we're talking to. Informal chats with friends are common, but a formal work-related call might require prior preparation and confidence. Telephone conversations, though they lack body language, offering the flexibility of communicating from a distance at any time. As we text and call from various locations, both sides can engage conversation without feeling pressured. So, which contact method do you prefer?
readings.translation: 在过去，直接的（direct）面对面交流（communication）是人们沟通（interact）的主要方式。当试图（try）联系在远方（ata distance）的人时，人们别无选择，只能耐心地（paticntly）等待（wait）数日，等待信件缓慢地送达。然而，得益于技术的社会服务与人际沟通（technological）发展（advancement），我们现在（now）可以使用电话（phone）、电子邮件（email）和视频通话。这些现代工具使我们能够立刻（instantly）联系到家人和朋友，无论（whether）他们在附近（nearby）还是在地球的另外（other）一端，从而消除（eliminate）了焦急（anxious）等待的需要，并让沟通变得更简便且成本更低（affordable）。面对面交谈（conversation）能提供（offer）直接人际互动（interaction）的独特优势，包括口头（spoken）语言、肢体语言（body language）和面部（facial）表情。研究表明，日常面对面交流中有93%依赖于（rely on）肢体语言。当仅（alone）靠言语无法清晰地表达意思时，肢体语言有助于建立信任（trust）并加强（strengthen）情感联系（bond）。例如，一个拥抱（hug）让（let）我们能够领会（grasp）某人真实的（true）情感，加深（deepen）我们之间的联系（connection）。但如果人们相距遥远或工作繁忙，电话和电子邮件就能帮上忙。我们可以打电话给远方的（faraway）朋友聊天，或者在深夜（lat eat night）给想念（miss）的人发电子邮件。电话交谈的内容因交谈对象而异。与朋友的非正式（informal）聊天很常见，但工作相关的正式（formal）通话可能需要事先的（prior）准备（preparation）和自信心（confidence）。电话（telephone）交谈虽然没有肢体语言，但提供了随时能远距离（fro madi stance）沟通的灵活性（flexibility）。当我们在不同地点（location）发信息（text）或打电话时，双方都可以参与（engage in）谈话而不会感到有压力（pressured）。那么，你更喜欢哪种联系（contact）方式呢？

sentences.en: However, thanks to technological advancements, we now have access to phones, emails, and video calls.

sentences.en: These modern tools enable us to instantly connect with family and friends, whether they are nearby or on the other side of the globe, eliminating the need for anxious waiting and making communication easier and more affordable.
sentences.cn: 这些现代工具使我们能够立刻（instantly）联系到家人和朋友，无论（whether）他们在附近（nearby）还是在地球的另外（other）一端，从而消除（eliminate）了焦急（anxious）等待的需要，并让沟通变得更简便且成本更低（affordable）。

sentences.en: Face-to-face conversations offer the unique advantage of direct personal interaction, including spoken words, body language, and facial expressions.

sentences.en: When words alone fail to convey meaning clearly, body language helps to build trust and strengthen emotional bonds.

readings.title: No Forced Apps Ads
readings.text: Have you noticed that when you open a certain mobile app, an advertisement usually pops up? When you attempt to close the ad or shake your device slightly, another ad might pop up suddenly, which greatly disturbs users' daily experience. Nowadays, some apps usually have shopping ads at the top and bottom of their pages. When you tap these ads accident, they will instantly take you to a shopping website. Even the photography app is frequently interrupted by sudden shoe ads. The exit button to close the ad is small and hidden. If you try to click it, another ad will appear on the screen. What's worse, some apps use the phone's sensor function to make ads pop up when you shake the phone. A college student, Yangyang, said, “I simply slid my finger across the phone screen, and a shopping website appeared all of a sudden!" His roommate Jack also expressed his frustration, “Ads keep popping up on the phone screen, which is really annoying!" Over 90 percent of users have a strong dislike of splash app ads, according to the Consumer Council. In fact, such ads hurt apps' reputation. Users may not want to use these apps anymore because of frequent ads. Mr Xie, a regular consumer, revealed that to prevent ads from appearing on another page, he had searched on multiple social platforms for strategies to deal with pop-up ads. “The results were not obvious. Even if a certain app was closed, novel forms of forced pop-up ads continued to emerge, Mr Xie said. A lawyer stated that such actions of app companies lack a legal basis. App companies should respect users' choices. An expert suggested that the relevant departments must make strict rules to regulate irregular ads. This can better safeguard users' proper rights.
readings.translation: 你是否注意到，当你打开某款手机应用程序（mobile app）时，通常会突然弹出（popup）一则广告（advertisement）？当你试图（attempt）关闭（close）该广告或者轻轻冕动一下你的设备（device）时，另一则广告可能会突然（suddenly）弹出，这极大地千扰（disturb）了用户的日常（daily）使用体验。如今，一些应用程序页面（page）的顶部（top）和底部（bottom）通常会有购物广告。当你无意中（by accident）轻点这些广告时，它们会立刻（instantly）带你进入一个购物网站（website）。就连摄影（photography）应用程序也频繁地（frequently）被突然出现的鞋子广告打断（interrupt）。关闭广告的退出（exit）按钮（button）又小又隐蔽（hidden）。如果你试图点击（click）它，另一个广告又会出现在屏幕（screen）上。更糟糕的是，一些应用程序利用手机的传感器功能（sensor function），在你冕动手机时就会弹出广告。一名大学生阳阳说：“我仅仅（simply）用手指（finger）在手机屏幕上滑动（slide），一个购物网站就突然出现了！”会（council）的数据显示，超过90%的用户对开屏广告有强烈的（strong）反感。事实上，这类广告会对应用程序的名誉（reputation）产生不良影响。由于频繁出现广告，用户可能会不再使用这些应用程序了。谢先生（Mr），一位普通的（regular）消费者，他透露（reveal），为了阻止（prevent）广告出现在另一个页面上，他在多个（multiple）社交平台（platform）上搜索（search）了解决（deal with）弹窗广告的策略。谢先生说：“结果并不明显用程序公司的此类行为缺乏法律依据（legal basis）。应用程序公司应该尊重用户的选择（choice）。一位专家建议，相关（relevant）部门必须制定严格的（strict）规定来管理（regulate）不合乎常规的（irregular）广告。这能更好地保护（safeguard）用户的正当（proper）权益。

sentences.en: Have you noticed that when you open a certain mobile app, an advertisement usually pops up?
sentences.cn: 你是否注意到，当你打开某款手机应用程序（mobile app）时，通常会突然弹出（popup）一则广告（advertisement）？

sentences.en: When you attempt to close the ad or shake your device slightly, another ad might pop up suddenly, which greatly disturbs users' daily experience.
sentences.cn: 当你试图（attempt）关闭（close）该广告或者轻轻冕动一下你的设备（device）时，另一则广告可能会突然（suddenly）弹出，这极大地千扰（disturb）了用户的日常（daily）使用体验。

sentences.en: Nowadays, some apps usually have shopping ads at the top and bottom of their pages.
sentences.cn: 如今，一些应用程序页面（page）的顶部（top）和底部（bottom）通常会有购物广告。

sentences.en: When you tap these ads accident, they will instantly take you to a shopping website.
sentences.cn: 当你无意中（by accident）轻点这些广告时，它们会立刻（instantly）带你进入一个购物网站（website）。

sentences.en: Even the photography app is frequently interrupted by sudden shoe ads.
sentences.cn: 就连摄影（photography）应用程序也频繁地（frequently）被突然出现的鞋子广告打断（interrupt）。

sentences.en: The exit button to close the ad is small and hidden.
sentences.cn: 关闭广告的退出（exit）按钮（button）又小又隐蔽（hidden）。

sentences.en: If you try to click it, another ad will appear on the screen.
sentences.cn: 如果你试图点击（click）它，另一个广告又会出现在屏幕（screen）上。

sentences.en: What's worse, some apps use the phone's sensor function to make ads pop up when you shake the phone.
sentences.cn: 更糟糕的是，一些应用程序利用手机的传感器功能（sensor function），在你冕动手机时就会弹出广告。

sentences.en: A college student, Yangyang, said, “I simply slid my finger across the phone screen, and a shopping website appeared all of a sudden!"
sentences.cn: 一名大学生阳阳说：“我仅仅（simply）用手指（finger）在手机屏幕上滑动（slide），一个购物网站就突然出现了！”

sentences.en: His roommate Jack also expressed his frustration, “Ads keep popping up on the phone screen, which is really annoying!" Over 90 percent of users have a strong dislike of splash app ads, according to the Consumer Council.
sentences.cn: 会（council）的数据显示，超过90%的用户对开屏广告有强烈的（strong）反感。

sentences.en: In fact, such ads hurt apps' reputation.
sentences.cn: 事实上，这类广告会对应用程序的名誉（reputation）产生不良影响。

sentences.en: Users may not want to use these apps anymore because of frequent ads.
sentences.cn: 由于频繁出现广告，用户可能会不再使用这些应用程序了。

sentences.en: Mr Xie, a regular consumer, revealed that to prevent ads from appearing on another page, he had searched on multiple social platforms for strategies to deal with pop-up ads.
sentences.cn: 谢先生（Mr），一位普通的（regular）消费者，他透露（reveal），为了阻止（prevent）广告出现在另一个页面上，他在多个（multiple）社交平台（platform）上搜索（search）了解决（deal with）弹窗广告的策略。

sentences.en: “The results were not obvious. Even if a certain app was closed, novel forms of forced pop-up ads continued to emerge, Mr Xie said. A lawyer stated that such actions of app companies lack a legal basis. App companies should respect users' choices. An expert suggested that the relevant departments must make strict rules to regulate irregular ads. This can better safeguard users' proper rights.
sentences.cn: 谢先生说：“结果并不明显用程序公司的此类行为缺乏法律依据（legal basis）。应用程序公司应该尊重用户的选择（choice）。一位专家建议，相关（relevant）部门必须制定严格的（strict）规定来管理（regulate）不合乎常规的（irregular）广告。这能更好地保护（safeguard）用户的正当（proper）权益。

readings.title: Chinese New-styleTea
readings.text: Chinese NewW-style Tea Enters the US Mixue, a well-known Chinese new-style tea brand, opened its first physical store in the US on December 20, 2025. This important event marks Mixue Group's official entry into the North American market and attracts great attention from local people. Many local residents and tourists stopped to take photos in front of the store, making it a popular spot shortly after its opening. Mixue has the advantage of low prices in the US, with products priced from $ 1.19 to $ 4.99. These prices are much lower than those of similar local brands, which makes Mixue popular among customers. Every day, large numbers of young people line up outside the store to buy its drinks. The data from social media shows that “Chinese new-style tea" has become a hot topic, and it has turned into an important way to spread Chinese culture around the world. In recent years, more and more Chinese new- style tea brands have been expanding overseas. Swere in At first, most of their first overseas s stores Southeast Asia. However, as the market there tended to be saturated, some brands began to turn to North America to pursue new business opportunities. Besides Mixue, other well-known Chinese new-style tea brands like Chagee also opened stores in the US in 2025. Heytea already opened its first store in the US in 2023. These stores have received positive reviews from American consumers for their delicious taste and reasonable prices Facing an increasing number of Chinese new- style tea brands in the US, an American social media user posted online: “I really enjoy these delicious Chinese drinks. I hope American companies are ready for some real competition" An expert shared his opinion, “"The new-style tea market in the US is growing rapidly, and there is no dominant brand, offering a window of opportunity for Chinese brands to seize market share." He added that the market will possibly attract more Chinese new- style tea brands to enter in the future, bringing more choices to American consumers.
readings.translation: （physical store）。这一重要事件标志（mark）着蜜雪集团正式（official）进入（entry）北美洲的（North American）市场（market），并吸引（attract）了当地民众的极大关注（attention）。许多当地居民（resident）和游客（tourist）驻足在门店前拍照，使它开业后不久（shortly）就成为了一个受欢迎的（popular）地点（spot）。蜜雪冰城在美国具有价格（price）低廉的优势（advantage），其产品标价在1.19美元到4.99美元之间。这些价格远低于当地类似的（similar）品牌的售价，这使得它深受顾客（customer）欢迎。每天，许多年轻人在门店外排队（lineup）购买（buy）其饮品。社交媒体（social media）上的数据显示，“新中式茶饮”已成为一个热门话题（hot topic），并已转变为向全世界传播（spread）中国文化（culture）的一种重要方式。近（recent）年来，越来越多的新中式茶饮品牌持续在国外（overseas）拓展（expand）。起初，它们的首批海外门店大多位于东南亚。然而，由于当地市场趋于（tend）饱和（saturated），一些品牌开始转向北美追求（pursue）新的商机（business opportunity）。除了蜜雪冰城，其他知名的新中式茶饮品牌如霸王茶姬也于2025年在美国开设了门店。喜茶已于2023年在美国开设了首家门店。这些门店凭借美味的（delicious）口感（taste）和合理的（reasonable）价格收获（receive）了美国消费者（consumer）的正面（positive）评价（review）。面对在美国不断增加的（increasing）新中式茶饮品牌，一位美国社交媒体用户在网上发帖（post）说：“我真的很喜欢这些美味的中国饮品。我希望美国企业为真正的竞争（competition）做好准备。”配地位的（dominant）品牌，这为中国的品牌抢占（seize）市场份额提供了机遇。”他还表示，在未来该市场可能（possibly）会吸引更多的中国新中式茶品牌进入（enter），为美国消费者带来更多选择（choice）。

readings.title: GHIN
readings.text: Kindness in an Airport There are moments when strangers' lives collide by sheer coincidence, and even though they may never cross paths again, they're changed forever. Such encounters often reveal true character through the unexpected generosity of unlikely heroes. Not long ago, I witnessed such a moment. On night midnight summer midnight, my parents and I had a silent just gotten off a long flight and walked through the deserted airport t terminal, when I saw a passenger suddenly collapse onto the floor. We immediately sprinted toward him. My parents, who are doctors, dropped everything and began to assess his condition, trying to figure out what had happened. As they asked him questions and searched for a medical information card, more fellow travellers gathered around. My parents diagnosed him with acute hypoglycemia and he was in major need of sugar. However, the only thing we could find was a protein bar. We were worried it would not be enough to save him. Just then, a young boy, Mecca, arrived at the scene with the flight attendants. He quietly announced, “I have some candies!" Nobody responded to him as they were in chaos. Mecca dug deep into his backpack and pulled them out. Then he handed them to my father. Within seconds of substituting the candies for the protein bar, the man regained consciousness. Mecca, a fourth grader, saved this stranger's life! No one could have guessed that earlier that night, Mecca had just been through a tough time. His father's flight was unexpectedly cancelled, forcing him to fly solo for the first time. To alleviate his re + gain: regain anxiety, his grandmother had stuffed his backpack with candies. When we informed Mecca's parents of his act, they smiled from ear to ear. They were amazed that Mecca had reserved something and had the presence of mind to offer it during the emergency. As time goes by, I am still greatly moved by Mecca's compassion in saving a stranger. Even today, his authentic kindness never fails to make me smile. energy
readings.translation: 有时，陌生人（stranger）的生活会因纯粹的巧合（coincidence）而产生交集（collide），即使他们以后也不会再次相遇（cross paths），但他们的人生也被永远地（forever）改变了。这类相逢，往往能从那些意料之外的英雄们（hero）发自本心的善意（generosity）中，展露出真实的人性。不久前，我目赌了这样一个时刻。在一个寂静的（silent）夏日（summer）午夜（midnight），我的父母和我刚结束一场长途航班，经过空无一人的（deserted）机场（airport）航站楼（terminal）时，我看到一位乘客（passenger）突然昏倒（collapse）在地板（floor）上。我们立刻冲（sprint）向他。我的父母是医生（doctor），他们放下手头的一切（everything），开始评估（assess）他的状况，试图弄清楚发生了什么。当他们向他提问并寻找医疗（medical）信息（information）卡（card）时，更多同行的（fellow）旅客（traveller）围了过来。我的父母诊断（diagnose）出他患有急性（acute）低血糖，急需（in major need of）糖分。然而，我们能找到的只有一根蛋白棒（protein bar）。我们担心这不足（enough）以救他。就在这时，一个名叫梅卡的年轻男孩和机组乘务员（flight attendant）一起赶到了现场（scene）。他轻声说道：“我有一些糖果（candy）！”没有人（nobody）回应（respond）他，因为他们正处于混乱（chaos）之中。梅卡在他的背包（backpack）深处寻找（dig），拿出了糖果。然后他把它们递给了我的父亲。在用糖果替代（substitute）蛋白棒的短短几秒钟（second）内，这名男子就恢复（regain）了意识。梅卡，一个四年级学生，救了这位陌生人的命！没人能料到（guess），当晚早些时候，梅卡刚刚经历了艰难的时刻。他父亲的航班意外被取消（cancel）了，这迫使他第一次独自坐飞机。为了缓解他的焦虑（anxiety），他的祖母在他的背包里塞满了糖果。当我们把梅卡的行为告诉（inform）他的父母时，他们笑得合不拢嘴（from ear to ear）。他们惊诉（amazed）梅卡储备（reserve）了一些东西，并且在紧急情况（emergency）下还能临危不乱（have the presence of mind）地拿出它。随着时间的流逝，我仍然被梅卡这种拯救陌生人的善意（compassion）深深打动。直到现在，他那真挚的（authentic）善良也总是让我会心一笑。

sentences.en: We were worried it would not be enough to save him.

sentences.en: Just then, a young boy, Mecca, arrived at the scene with the flight attendants.
sentences.cn: 就在这时，一个名叫梅卡的年轻男孩和机组乘务员（flight attendant）一起赶到了现场（scene）。

sentences.en: He quietly announced, “I have some candies!"

sentences.en: Nobody responded to him as they were in chaos.

sentences.en: Mecca dug deep into his backpack and pulled them out.

sentences.en: Then he handed them to my father.

sentences.en: Within seconds of substituting the candies for the protein bar, the man regained consciousness.

sentences.en: Mecca, a fourth grader, saved this stranger's life!
sentences.cn: 梅卡，一个四年级学生，救了这位陌生人的命！

sentences.en: No one could have guessed that earlier that night, Mecca had just been through a tough time.

sentences.en: His father's flight was unexpectedly cancelled, forcing him to fly solo for the first time.

sentences.en: They were amazed that Mecca had reserved something and had the presence of mind to offer it during the emergency.

sentences.en: As time goes by, I am still greatly moved by Mecca's compassion in saving a stranger.
sentences.cn: 随着时间的流逝，我仍然被梅卡这种拯救陌生人的善意（compassion）深深打动。

readings.title: Delivery Riders as Food Safety
readings.titleCn: 外卖骑手：食品安全的守护者
readings.text: Beijing is recruiting food delivery riders to act as frontline food safety supervisors, aiming to enhance oversight in the city's massive online food service sector. The program, announced by the local market massive supervision department, encourages riders to report problems they see when picking up or delivering food, such as dirty kitchens or unlicensed operations, using in-app tools to take photos and send reports. Platforms do an initial check before forwarding verified clues to regulators, forming a closed-loop system in which authorities investigate and give feedback on the results. Riders receive rewards for confirmed reports. This movement reflects a broader shift toward shared governance, government combining supervision, platform responsibility, and public participation. Regulators also plan to study reporting patterns to identify potential risks and carry out targeted checks. Several Beijing districts have tested the idea. Tongzhou has launched a mini-program to simplify the reporting process. These trials have shown early promise. This positive feedback is encouraging more districts to join. Similar initiatives have been rolled out in many regions, where authorities and delivery platforms have mobilized riders to report food safety risks. Some places have already reported positive results. In Qiandongnan, Guizhou, more than 4o0 riders joined as volunteers. Since the program started this year, they have sent 42 tips, all of which were confirmed, leading to six official investigations, according to local media. One rider recalled reporting a restaurant where staff weren't wearing masks while handling food and didn't have health certificates. "I took photos and uploaded the evidence he said."Within two days, regulators confirmed the problems and ordered fixes." He later got a reward and said the experience made his work more meaningful. Back in Beijing, reactions are mixed. Some riders welcome the extra role. A rider with three years of experience said the policy could improve food hygiene standards. “"We see kitchen conditions every day," he said. "With proper rules, things should get better." Consumers also support the idea. Wang Haoqing, a sense of security" when ordering takeout. Similarly, Zhou Yan, a 32-year-old tech employee, said riders have unique insights into hygiene conditions. However, other riders are cautious. They are worried about the tight delivery schedules and heavy workloads. “We're racing against the clock," one said. “Extra tasks could hurt our efficiency and income." Authorities said offering good rewards, providing comprehensive training, and ensuring user-friendly reporting tools will be key to balancing supervision workloads. and riders'
readings.translation: 北京市正在动员（recruit）配送（delivery）骑手（rider）担任一线（frontline）食品安全监督员（supervisor），旨在加强（enhance）对该市庞大的（massive）在线食品服务行业（sector）的监管（oversight）。该计划由当地市场监管部门（department）公布（announce），鼓励骑手在取餐或送餐时，使用应用内的工具拍照（photo）并发送（send）举报（report）内容，举报他们看到的问题（problem），例如脏乱的厨房或无执照（unlicensed）经营。平台先进行初步的核查，然后将核实过的线索转交（forward）给监管机构（regulator），由官方（authority）调查（investigate）并对结果进行反馈（feedback），形成一个闭环系统。对于已确认的（confirmed）举报，骑手可获得奖励（reward）。这一行动（movement）反映出向“共治（governance）”更广泛的（broad）转变，即结合（combine）政府监管、平台责任（responsibility）和公众参与（participation）。监管部门还计划研究（study）举报模式，以发现潜在的（potential）风险，并开展针对性检查。北京已有几个地区（district）试行了这一想法。通州区已经推出（launch）了一个小程序来简化举报流程。这些试点（trial）已初见成效（promise）。这种积极的（positive）反馈正鼓励更多地区加入（join）。类似的倡议（initiative）已在许多地区推出（roll out），官方和配送平台动员（mobilize）骑手举报食品安全隐惠。一些（some）地方已经报道了积极成效。在贵州黔东南，已有400多名骑手作为志愿者（volunteer）加入。据地方媒体报道，自今年（year）他举报了一家餐厅（restaurant），那个地方（where）的员工（staff）在处理食物时没有戴口罩（mask），而且他们也没有健题并责令整改。”他后来获得了奖励，并表示这段经历让他的工作更有意义。回到北京，人们的反应（reaction）不一。一些骑手欢迎这个额外的角色。一位有三（three）年工作经验的骑手表示，该政策有助于提高食品卫生（hygiene）标准（standard）。“我们每天都看到厨房的状况，”他说。“有了完善的制度（rule），情况应该会好转。”消费者（consumer）们也支持这个想法。一位名叫王浩清的金融（finance）从业者表示，该制度在人们外卖（takeout）点餐时给了一种“额外的安全（security）感”。同样，32岁的科技职员（employee）周燕表示，骑手对卫生状况有着独特的见解。然而，其他骑手则持谨慎（cautious）态度。他们担心紧张的配送时间安排和繁重的工作量（workload）。官方表示，提供良好的奖励、全面的（comprehensive）培训以及确保（ensure）便于使用的举报工具，将是平衡监管与骑手工作量的关键。

readings.title: College Rankings vs Teaching Quality
readings.titleCn: 大学排名与教学质量之辩
readings.text: It's an exciting but stressful time of year for students in America, as they decide which college to attend. Many families turn to the ranking list of universities to help make the choice. However, these rankings leave out a key factor the overall quality of classroom teaching. As a scholar of higher education, I often talk with families of applicants. They are usually astonished that teaching quality is not involved in the rankings. New studies show that courses in universities whose ranks are lower score higher on teaching than those in higher-ranked ones. In fact, universities often shift emphasis from teaching to other ranking factors. The absence of teaching from the rankings seems ridiculous, considering the close association between high-standard teaching and students' academic achievements. Quality teaching is one of the most important predictors of college outcomes. Rankings are only one reason for the low recognition of teaching in higher education. Administrators seldom view teaching excellence as a way to increase enrolment or funding. Therefore, it is rarely valued in hiring or promotion. Research shows that the more time tutors spend on teaching, the lower their salary is. So many instructors continue to instruct using traditional lectures, which leads to lower success rates. Efforts to improve teaching at the university level have recently emerged. Nevertheless, limited progress will be achieved unless schools with superior teaching are rewarded with abundant resources, higher rankings and larger enrolment scales. In the long term, universities, organizations that rank schools, and others should work together to make teaching a respected, core part of the educational missions. Under the circumstances, what should students and their families do? In practice, students and their families can take several concrete steps to identify such institutions. They should give strong consideration to universities where high-quality teaching is valued. Instead of relying solely on popular rankings, they can examine other indicators, such as the ratio of teachers and students. It is also helpful to hear what current students say. They can speak honestly about the accessibility of professors and the extent to which teaching is the top priority. Over time, valuing teaching quality in the college selection process can generate broader rewards. When more people express a strong preference for universities known for better instruction, those institutions will be partly motivated to invest further in pedagogical development, reward excellent educators, and make teaching excellence a visible part of their identity. Such a shift may also press ranking organizations to evaluate their criteria. Students and their families can also become powerful advocates for a system in which high-quality teaching is recognized as essential to education.
readings.translation: 对于美国高中生来说，每年这个时候既令人兴奋（exciting）又紧张（stressful），因为他们要决定（decide）去哪所大学（college）就读。许多家庭会参考大学排行榜（ranking list）来做扶择。然而，这些排名遗漏了一个关键因素（factor）课堂教学的整体（overall）质量。作为一名高等（higher）教育学者（scholar），我经常与申请人（applicant）的家庭交流。他们通常感到十分惊（astonished），教学质量未被包含（involve）在排名的考核标准中。新的研究表明，排名较低的（lower）大学的课程在教学方面得分（score）高于那些排名较高的大学。事实上，大学往往将重点（emphasis）从教学转移（shift）到其他排名因素。考虑到高质量教学与学生学业（academic）成绩之间的密切联系（association），教学在排名中的缺席（absence）似乎很荒谬（ridiculous）。优质教学是大学众多育人成果（outcome）的最重要的衡量指标（predictor）之一。排名只是高等教育教学认可（recognition）度低的原因之一。管理人员（administrator）很少（seldom）将优质教学视为增加入学人数（enrolment）或增加资金的一种方式。因此，它在录用（hire）或晋升（promotion）中很少（rarely）受到重视。研究表明，高校教师（tutor）花在教学上的时间越多，他们的工资就越低。因此许多教师仍沿用传统的讲课方式（lecture）进行教授（instruct），最终导致学业通过率（rate）偏低。近些年，各大高校陆续推出提升教学质量的相关举措。然而，除非（unless）那些教学质量更胜一筹的（superior）学校能获得大量的（abundant）资源、更高的排名和更大的招生规模（scale），否则进展仍将是有限的（limited）。从长远来看，大学、第三方院校排名机构（organization）和其他各方应一起（together）努力，使教学成为教育的（educational）使命中受人尊敬的（respected）核心部分。在这种状况（circumstance）下，学生和他们的家庭应该怎么做呢？实际上（in practice），学生和他们的家庭可以采取几个具体的（concrete）方法来识别这样的院校（institution）。他们应该优先考虑（consideration）重视高质量教学的大学。他们还可以考察其他指标，而不是仅（solely）依赖于热门排名，比如老师（teacher）和学生的比例（ratio）。听（hear）在校学生怎么说也很有帮助。他们能够诚实地（honestly）讲述（speak）教授是否容易接触（accessibility）以及学校将教学放在首要位置（priority）的程度（extent）。从长远来看，在大学选择（selection）过程中重视教学质量能够产生（generate）更广泛的回报。当越来越多的人强烈偏爱（preference）以教学出色而闻名的大学时，这些院校就会在一定程度上（partly）受到激励，进一步投入（invest）教学（pedagogical）建设、奖励优秀教育工作者（educator），并让出色的教学成为他们特征的一个明显的（visible）组成部分。这种改变也可能促使排名机构重新评估（evaluate）其标准（criterion）。学生和他们的家长也能成为一个体系的有力倡导者（advocate），在这个体系中，高质量的教学被视为教育所必要的（essential）。

sentences.en: It's an exciting but stressful time of year for students in America, as they decide which college to attend.
sentences.cn: 对于美国高中生来说，每年这个时候既令人兴奋（exciting）又紧张（stressful），因为他们要决定（decide）去哪所大学（college）就读。

sentences.en: Many families turn to the ranking list of universities to help make the choice.
sentences.cn: 许多家庭会参考大学排行榜（ranking list）来做扶择。

sentences.en: However, these rankings leave out a key factor the overall quality of classroom teaching.
sentences.cn: 然而，这些排名遗漏了一个关键因素（factor）课堂教学的整体（overall）质量。

sentences.en: As a scholar of higher education, I often talk with families of applicants.
sentences.cn: 作为一名高等（higher）教育学者（scholar），我经常与申请人（applicant）的家庭交流。

sentences.en: They are usually astonished that teaching quality is not involved in the rankings.
sentences.cn: 他们通常感到十分惊（astonished），教学质量未被包含（involve）在排名的考核标准中。

sentences.en: New studies show that courses in universities whose ranks are lower score higher on teaching than those in higher-ranked ones.
sentences.cn: 新的研究表明，排名较低的（lower）大学的课程在教学方面得分（score）高于那些排名较高的大学。

sentences.en: In fact, universities often shift emphasis from teaching to other ranking factors.
sentences.cn: 事实上，大学往往将重点（emphasis）从教学转移（shift）到其他排名因素。

sentences.en: The absence of teaching from the rankings seems ridiculous, considering the close association between high-standard teaching and students' academic achievements.
sentences.cn: 考虑到高质量教学与学生学业（academic）成绩之间的密切联系（association），教学在排名中的缺席（absence）似乎很荒谬（ridiculous）。

sentences.en: Quality teaching is one of the most important predictors of college outcomes.
sentences.cn: 优质教学是大学众多育人成果（outcome）的最重要的衡量指标（predictor）之一。

sentences.en: Rankings are only one reason for the low recognition of teaching in higher education.
sentences.cn: 排名只是高等教育教学认可（recognition）度低的原因之一。

sentences.en: Administrators seldom view teaching excellence as a way to increase enrolment or funding.
sentences.cn: 管理人员（administrator）很少（seldom）将优质教学视为增加入学人数（enrolment）或增加资金的一种方式。

sentences.en: Therefore, it is rarely valued in hiring or promotion.
sentences.cn: 因此，它在录用（hire）或晋升（promotion）中很少（rarely）受到重视。

sentences.en: Research shows that the more time tutors spend on teaching, the lower their salary is.
sentences.cn: 研究表明，高校教师（tutor）花在教学上的时间越多，他们的工资就越低。

sentences.en: So many instructors continue to instruct using traditional lectures, which leads to lower success rates.
sentences.cn: 因此许多教师仍沿用传统的讲课方式（lecture）进行教授（instruct），最终导致学业通过率（rate）偏低。

sentences.en: Efforts to improve teaching at the university level have recently emerged.
sentences.cn: 近些年，各大高校陆续推出提升教学质量的相关举措。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, limited progress will be achieved unless schools with superior teaching are rewarded with abundant resources, higher rankings and larger enrolment scales.
sentences.cn: 然而，除非（unless）那些教学质量更胜一筹的（superior）学校能获得大量的（abundant）资源、更高的排名和更大的招生规模（scale），否则进展仍将是有限的（limited）。

sentences.en: In the long term, universities, organizations that rank schools, and others should work together to make teaching a respected, core part of the educational missions.
sentences.cn: 从长远来看，大学、第三方院校排名机构（organization）和其他各方应一起（together）努力，使教学成为教育的（educational）使命中受人尊敬的（respected）核心部分。

sentences.en: Under the circumstances, what should students and their families do?
sentences.cn: 在这种状况（circumstance）下，学生和他们的家庭应该怎么做呢？

sentences.en: In practice, students and their families can take several concrete steps to identify such institutions.
sentences.cn: 实际上（in practice），学生和他们的家庭可以采取几个具体的（concrete）方法来识别这样的院校（institution）。

sentences.en: They should give strong consideration to universities where high-quality teaching is valued.
sentences.cn: 他们应该优先考虑（consideration）重视高质量教学的大学。

sentences.en: Instead of relying solely on popular rankings, they can examine other indicators, such as the ratio of teachers and students.
sentences.cn: 他们还可以考察其他指标，而不是仅（solely）依赖于热门排名，比如老师（teacher）和学生的比例（ratio）。

sentences.en: It is also helpful to hear what current students say.
sentences.cn: 听（hear）在校学生怎么说也很有帮助。

sentences.en: They can speak honestly about the accessibility of professors and the extent to which teaching is the top priority.
sentences.cn: 他们能够诚实地（honestly）讲述（speak）教授是否容易接触（accessibility）以及学校将教学放在首要位置（priority）的程度（extent）。

sentences.en: Over time, valuing teaching quality in the college selection process can generate broader rewards.
sentences.cn: 从长远来看，在大学选择（selection）过程中重视教学质量能够产生（generate）更广泛的回报。

sentences.en: When more people express a strong preference for universities known for better instruction, those institutions will be partly motivated to invest further in pedagogical development, reward excellent educators, and make teaching excellence a visible part of their identity.
sentences.cn: 当越来越多的人强烈偏爱（preference）以教学出色而闻名的大学时，这些院校就会在一定程度上（partly）受到激励，进一步投入（invest）教学（pedagogical）建设、奖励优秀教育工作者（educator），并让出色的教学成为他们特征的一个明显的（visible）组成部分。

sentences.en: Such a shift may also press ranking organizations to evaluate their criteria.
sentences.cn: 这种改变也可能促使排名机构重新评估（evaluate）其标准（criterion）。

sentences.en: Students and their families can also become powerful advocates for a system in which high-quality teaching is recognized as essential to education.
sentences.cn: 学生和他们的家长也能成为一个体系的有力倡导者（advocate），在这个体系中，高质量的教学被视为教育所必要的（essential）。

readings.title: The World Changers
readings.text: Think of somebody you really admire, and you will probably find that their success wasn't handed to them on a silver platter. What's more, their work may have even reshaped the world. As “the Father of Hybrid Rice", Yuan Longping overcame great difficulties and dedicated his entire life to alleviating global hunger. Thanks to him, people in our country with a large population have sufficient food. Wu Mengchao, “the Father of Chinese Hepatobiliary to saving people's lives. Throughout his lifetime, he did over 16, o00 operations. Due to gripping the scalpel for such a long time, his fingers were out of shape. His dedication gave countless people an opportunity to live. Tu Youyou is a pharmacologist. In 1969, she assumed the leadership role of a research team. With the aim of addressing the challenge of malaria treatment, she and her colleagues conducted treat+ment= treatment extensive research on the disease. However, their initial findings S were disappointing. Instead of giving up, they persisted in their efforts. Eventually, in 1972, they made it! Decades later, in 2015, she was awarded the Nobel Prize at the age of 85. The discovery, Artemisinin, has saved the lives of people suffering from malaria around the world. Another inspiring figure is Qian Xuesen, known as “the Father of Chinese Rocketry". Despite commit+ ment=commitment wavered in facing numerous obstacles, Qian never his commitment to advancing China's aerospace technology. After returning to his homeland, he dedicated himself to developing China's missile and space programs, laying the foundation for the country's rapid progress in these fields. His pioneering work not only pushed China into the ranks of space- faring nations but also inspired generations of Chinese scientists and engineers to pursue excellence engineer in their fields. These great people, Yuan Longping, Wu Mengchao, Tu Youyou, and Qian Xuesen all stuck to their targets, regardless of the immense challenges they faced. They didn't merely fulfill their personal dreams. Their contributions have significantly improved our lives. Moreover, their spirit teaches us a valuable lesson we should press forward, even when things are hard. (press forward)。 beaker test tube erlenmeyer flask graduated cylinder dropper syringe
readings.translation: 想一想你真正敬佩（admire）的某个人（somebody），你可能（probably）会发现，他们的成功（success）并非轻而易举地（ona silver platter）得到。此外，他们的工作（work）甚至（even）可能已经重塑（reshape）了世界。作为“杂交水稻（rice）之父”，袁隆平克服（overcome）了巨大的困难（difficulty），并将一生奉献（dedicate）给了缓解（alleviate）全球饥饿（的事业）。多亏了他，我们这个人口（population）大国（country）的人民才有了充足的（sufficient）食物（food）。“中国肝胆外科（surgery）之父”吴孟超，将自已生命中几乎（almost）八十年的时光都奉献给了拯救人们生命（的事业）。在他的一生中（throughout），他做了超过16000例手术（operation）。由于长时间紧握（grip）手术刀，他的手指都变了形。他的付出给了无数人活下去的机会（opportunity）。屠呦呦是一位药理学家（pharmacologist）。1969年，她承担（assume）了一个研究团队的领导（leadership）角色（role）。为了（with the aim of）应对（address）疾治疗（treatment）这一挑战（challenge），她和她的同事们（colleague）对这种疾病进行（conduct）了大量的（extensive）研究。然而，他们最初的（initial）研究结果（finding）是令人失望的（disappointing）。他们没有放弃，而是坚持不解地（persist in）努力。最终，在1972年，他们成功了！数十年后，在2015年，85岁的她被授予了诺贝尔奖。青蒿素的发现已经挽救了全世界无数疟疾惠者的生命。另一位鼓舞人心的（inspiring）人物是钱学森，他被誉为“中国火箭之父”。尽管面临众多的（numerous）障碍（obstacle），钱学森推动中国航天（aerospace）技术（technology）发展的承诺（commitment）从未（never）动摇（waver）。回到祖国（homeland）后，他致力于中国的导弹（missile）和航天项目（program），为国家在这些领域的快速发展奠定（lay）了基础（foundation）。他的开拓性（pioneering）研究成果不仅将中国推（push）入了航天国家（nation）的行列（rank），还激励了一代代中国科学家和工程师（engineer）在各自的领域追求卓越（excellence）。袁隆平、吴孟超、屠和钱学森这些伟大的（great）人物，不管（regardless）面对多么巨大的（immense）挑战，他们都（all）坚守自已的目标（target）。他们不仅实现（fulfill）了个人梦想，而且他们的贡献（contribution）已经显著地（significantly）改善了我们的生活。此外，他们的精神教会了我们宝贵的一课（lesson）一一即使困难重重，我们也应当（should）奋力向前

readings.title: DronesFlying Helpers in China
readings.titleCn: 无人机——中国的飞行助手
readings.text: At the Badaling section of the Great Wall in Beijing, people once spent fifty minutes walking to obtain food and water. Now, they can place orders via telephone, and drones bring these supplies within a few minutes. The drones can also remove the rubbish left by tourists on their way back. This is just an example of the widespread use of drones in China. By June 2024, more than 1.87 million drones had been allowed to operate, China Daily reported. More professional drone pilots are needed, but now only about 225,000 people have the required licenses. This leads to a shortage of qualified drone pilots in China. Drones are employed in many fields, such as agriculture, video shooting and environmental protection. So pilots can work in different industries and earn considerable salaries. That's why more people are taking training courses to get drone licenses. A training company in Hunan had 400 to 500 graduates in 2024. To get a license for flying drones below 120 meters, people need 44 hours of training. For flights beyond this height, 56 hours of training are required. The popularity of drones is connected with the low-altitude economy. It refers to a range of economic activities that take place in the airspace below 3, o00 meters above the ground. Drones will also influence the development of other industries. Drones will cooperate with artificial intelligence and green energy in the future. To meet the rising demand for drone pilots, relevant departments have taken measures to standardize training systems and simplify license procedures. With the continuous application advancement of technology, drones will play a more vital role in social development, bringing more convenience to people's lives and being applied in more contexts in the near future. drone delivery aerial security agricultural drone air rescue Low-altitude Economy drone show aerial photography
readings.translation: 在北京八达岭长城段，从前人们需要步行50（fifty）分钟才能得到（obtain）食物和水。现在，他们可以通过（via）电话下订单（place order），无人机（drone）在几分钟内（withinafewminutes）就能把这些物资（supply）送到。无人机还可以在返程的路上带走（remove）游客的垃圾（rubbish）。这仅是无人机在中国广泛（widespread）使用的一个例子。据《中国日报》报道（report），截至2024年6月，已有超过187万架无人机获准运营（operate）。市场需要更多专业（professional）无人机驾驶员（pilot），但目前只有大约22.5万人拥有所需的执照（license）。这导致中国符合资格的（qualified）无人机驾驶员（shortage）的短缺。无人机被应用（employ）于诸多领域，如农业（agriculture）、影视拍摄（shooting）、环境（environmental）保护等。因此，（无人机）飞行员可以在不同的行业（industry）工作，并获得相当多的（considerable）薪水（salary）。这就是为什么越来越多的人参加培训（training）课程（course）来获得无人机执照。湖南的一家培训公司在2024年有400到500名毕业生（graduate）。要考取120米以下（below）低空飞行执照需要完成44课时的培训。超过这个高度（height）的飞行（flight）则要求（require）完成56课时的训练。无人机的流行（popularity）与低空经济（economy）相关联（connect with）。低空经济是指在距离地面（ground）3000米以下的空域（airspace）进行的一系列（a range of）经济活动。无人机也将影响其他行业的发展。未来，无人机将与人工智能（artificalintelligence）、绿色能源（energy）合作（cooperate with）。为了满足对无人机飞行员日益增长（rising）的需求（demand），相关（relevant）部门已采取措施，使培训制度标准化（standardize），简化（simplify）执照申请（application）程序（procedure）。随着科技的不断（continuous）进步，在不久的将来，无人机将在社会发展中发挥更重要的作用，为人们的生活带来更多的便利（convenience）和好处，并在更多的场景（context）中得到应用（apply）。

readings.title: The Amazing Humanoid Robot Games
readings.titleCn: 精彩的人形机器人运动会
readings.text: Beijing hosted the first World Humanoid Robot Games in August 2025. It marked the world's first event that integrated sports, arts and applied scenarios. It highlighted advancements in robotics technology. A professor said that the Games helped to “give the public a realistic impression of what things really are." The Games showed the latest achievements of China's humanoid robots. It also successfully filled the gap in international competitions in this field. A total of 280 teams from 16 countries brought hundreds of robots to compete. ceremony，the robots showed At the opening great skills. They jumped, danced, performed kung fu, and even took part in a fashion show with human models. During the competition, some robots could successfully navigate rough terrain. However, things were not always smooth. Many robots fell down, crashed into each other or experienced technical faults. They needed humans to repair them; otherwise, they could not continue competing. There were also a couple of falls during a soccer match. But one robot managed to solve the problem by itself in the end. In spite of this, just like real athletes, people cheered loudly after a robot scored a nice goal with a quick shot, or won the game at the last minute. Some people even stood up and waved colorful signs. It was such a lively scene. But the Games also raised questions about how far robots could go on their own. They did some great things, but still needed humans to help. Batteries needed replacing and broken parts needed fixing, so the robots often stayed close to their human operators. China is trying its best to do more research with the aim of inventing more efficient humanoid robots and is promoting rapid progress in robot technology through government investment. These smart robots will be used in all walks of life. Artificialintelligence technology allows machines to do a wider range of basic tasks. readings.translation: 2025年8月，北京主办（host）了首届世界人形机器人（humanoid robot）运动会。这是全球首次将体育、艺术和应用（applied）场景相结合（integrate）的赛事。该赛事突出（highlight）了机器人科学（robotics）技术（technology）的进展。一位教授（professor）表示，此次比赛有助于“让公众（public）对实际（realistic）情况有一个真实的印象（impression）”这个比赛展示（show）了中国人形机器人（领域）的最新（latest）科研成果。同时，这场运动会也成功填补（fil）了该领域（field）在国际（international）赛事中的空白。来自16个国家的共计280支队伍带来了数百台机器人参与竞赛（compete）。在开幕式（opening ceremony）上，这些机器人展示了出色的技能。它们跳跃（jump）、跳舞（dance）、表演（perform）功夫（kung fu），甚至还与真人模特同台参加时装表演（fashion show）。在比赛中，一些机器人能够成功地穿过高低不平的（rough）地形。然而，事情并非总是顺利的（smooth）。许多机器人摔倒、相互碰撞（crash into）或者出现技术故障（fault）。它们需要人类来修理（repair）；否则（otherwise），它们就无法继续竞赛了。在一场足球（soccer）比赛（match）中也有几次（a couple of）摔倒的情况发生。但有一台机器人最后自己（itself）解决了问题。尽管如此，就像真正的运动员（athlete）一样，当机器人凭借一次快速的射门（shot）踢进一个漂亮的球（scored anice goal）之后或在最后一刻赢得比赛时，人们都会大声欢呼。有些人甚至站起来挥动（wave）着五颜六色的标牌（sign）。这一场面（scene）十分热闹。但这些比赛也引起（raise）了关于机器人能在多大程度上自主运作的思考。它们虽然能做一些厉害的事情，但仍需要人类的协助。电池（battery）需要替换（replace），损坏的部件需要修理，因此这些机器人通常会紧贴着人类操作员行动。中国正全力以赴做更多研究，旨在发明（invent）出更高效的（efficient）人形机器人，并通过政府投资（investment）推动（promote）机器人技术的迅速（rapid）发展。这些智能机器人不久将被应用于各行各业。人工智能（artificialintelligence）技术使机器（machine）能够执行范围（range）更广的基础任务。
