sentences.en: column of air.
sentences.cn: 龙卷风（tornado）是一种猛烈地（violently）旋转的（rotating）柱状（column）气流。

sentences.en: Atornadoisaviolentlyrotating It can travel at over 200 miles per hour and result in great damage.
sentences.cn: 它每小时可移动超过200英里并会导致（result in）巨大的损失（damage）。

sentences.en: When moving across the land, it can readily lift cars, lorries and other vehicles, and even houses, then throw them far away onto the ground or buildings.
sentences.cn: 当它在陆地（land）上移动时，能够轻而易举地（readily）卷起小汽车（car）、卡车（lorry）以及其他车辆（vehicle），甚至房屋（house），然后将它们抛（throw）到远处的地面或建筑物（building）上面（onto）。

sentences.en: The wind raises dust, which easily enters your nose and mouth.
sentences.cn: 狂风卷起尘土，尘土很容易进入你的鼻子（nose）和嘴巴（mouth）。

sentences.en: So it's very important to find a hiding place when a tornado attacks.
sentences.cn: 因此，当遭遇龙卷风袭击（attack）时，找到一个躲避的地方是非常重要的。

sentences.en: A safe place can be a basement or the lowest floor of a building.
sentences.cn: 安全的地方可以是地下室（basement）或者建筑物的最底层。

sentences.en: If your home has no basement, seek refuge in a first-floor bathroom or a small windowless room in the middle of the house.
sentences.cn: 如果你的家没有地下室，那就到一楼的浴室（bathroom）或者房子中间一个无窗的（windowless）小房间里寻找避难所（refuge）。

sentences.en: Once inside, you should crouch down, curl up into a ball and cover your head and neck with your hands.
sentences.cn: 进入之后，你应该尊下（crouch down），蜷缩（curl up）成一团，并用双手护住（cover）头部和颈部（neck）。

sentences.en: To learn more about tornadoes' characteristics and how they form, some scientists make a decisive move to get close to these hazardous natural phenomena.
sentences.cn: 为了更深入地了解龙卷风的特征以及它们是怎样形成（form）的，一些科学家采取了果断的（decisive）行动去接近这些危险的（hazardous）自然现象。

sentences.en: They use specialized equipment a tornado probe.
sentences.cn: 他们使用专门的（specialized）设备（equipment）一一龙卷风探测仪。

sentences.en: It is an important instrument.
sentences.cn: 这是一种重要的仪器。

sentences.en: It has precise sensors that can collect accurate data such as wind speed, temperature, atmospheric pressure and wind direction.
sentences.cn: 它配备了精确的传感器，能够收集诸如风速（wind speed）、温度（temperature）、大气压（atmospheric pressure）和风向（wind direction）等精确的（accurate）数据。

sentences.en: Some types of it even have compact cameras to take real-time photographs of tornadoes. By evaluating the collected data, scientists forecast where a tornado will move next.
sentences.cn: 有些型号的探测仪甚至还配有小型的照相机（camera），能够拍摄龙卷风实时的照片通过评估（evaluate）收集到的数据，科学家能够预测（forecast）龙卷风接下来会移动到何处。

sentences.en: Afterwards, they drive to the predicted place and put the probe in the right position.
sentences.cn: 之后（afterwards），他们会开车前往（drive to）预测的地点，并将探测仪放置在正确的位置（position）。

sentences.en: If their prediction is correct, the tornado will pass near or right over the probe, allowing it to collect data usefully.
sentences.cn: 如果他们的预测（prediction）是准确的，那么龙卷风就会从探测仪附近或正上方经过（pass），从而使其能够有效地（usefully）收集数据。

sentences.en: These data are used to refine predictive models for upcoming tornadoes.
sentences.cn: 这些数据被用于改进（refine）对即将来临的（upcoming）龙卷风的预测（predictive）模型。

sentences.en: Besides, they can be used to make timely warning announcements and reduce the risks to people's lives and property.
sentences.cn: 此外，这些数据还可用于发布及时的（timely）预警通告（announcement），降低危及民众生命（life）和财产（property）的风险。

readings.title: Artemis II a Space Exploration
readings.titleCn: 阿尔忒弥斯二号：太空探索
readings.text: The four astronauts of NASA's Artemis IImission safely returned to Earth on April 10, 2026, capping a historic 10-day journey around the Moon. The Orion spacecraft splashed down smoothly in the Pacific Ocean, marking humanity's first crewed flight beyond low Earth orbit in more than 50 years. Launched on April 1, the mission set a new record for the longest distance humans have ever traveled from Earth. The crew looped around the far side of the Moon, observing the lunar surface and capturing breathtaking images of meteor craters, ancient landscapes, and the the lunar horizon. During the flight, they informally named a small crater near the lunar limb "Carroll" in memory of the commander's late wife. The mission took its name Artemis from the Greek goddess of the Moon, the twin sister of Apollo, establishing a clear link to NASA's classic Apollo lunar program. The Orion spacecraft was named after a well-known constellation, representing humanity's drive to explore outer space. As a milestone in global space exploration, Artemis II carries deep and universal significance for humankind. The international crew demonstrated the power of cooperation in exploring the universe. The mission tested key systems of the Orion spacecraft including life support, heat shields, and deep- space navigation providing invaluable data for future lunar exploration and potential missions to Mars. The vivid images recorded during the flight also revealed the beauty of the solar system, arousing public interest and inspiring young people to pursue science and technology. With its successful completion, Artemis II completed a remarkable test flight and opened a new for humanity.
readings.translation: 美国国家航空航天局“阿耳弥斯2号”太空飞行任务（mission）的四名宇航员（astronaut）于2026年4月10日安全地（safely）返回地球，结束了为期10天环绕月球（Moon）的历史性的（historic）旅程。“猎户座”飞船（the Orion spacecraft）顺利地（smoothly）在太平洋（the Pacific Ocean）溅落，这标志着人类（humanity）50多年来首次执行离开近地轨道（low Earth orbit）的载人飞行（flight）任务。该任务于4月1日发射，创下了人类从地球出发后飞行（travel）距离最长的新纪录。机组人员（crew）环绕（loop）月球背面飞行，观测月球表面（surface），并拍摄了（capture）令人赞叹的（breathtaking）陨石坑（meteor crater）、古老地貌以及壮观的（spectacular）“地落”图像（image）一一我们的行星（planet）悬挂在月球地平线（horizon）上方。飞行期间，他们非正式地（informally）将靠近月球边缘（limb）的一个小陨石坑命名为“卡罗尔”，以纪念指挥官（commander）已故的（late）妻子。该任务以希腊的（Greek）月亮女神阿耳忒弥斯，阿波罗的双胞胎（twin）姐妹的名字命名，这与NASA经典的（classic）阿波罗探月计划（program）建立了明确的联系（link）。“猎户座”飞船是以一个有名的（well-know）星座（constellation）命名的，象征（represent）着人类探索外太空（outer space）的不解追求。作为全球太空探索（exploration）的一个里程碑（milestone），阿耳忒弥斯2号对人类具有深远且普遍的（universal）意义。国际机组人员证明（demonstrate）了人类探索宇宙（universe）合作（cooperation）的力量。此次任务测试了“猎户座”飞船的关键系统，包括生命维持、隔热罩和深空导航（navigation），为未来的月球探索以及潜在的（potential）火星（Mars）任务提供了极其珍贵的（invaluable）数据（data）。飞行过程中拍摄的生动图像也展现了太阳系（solar system）的美丽，引起（arouse）了公众的（public）兴趣，并激励了年轻人投身于科学和技术领域。随着（with）此次任务的成功完成（completion），阿耳忒弥斯2号完成了一次非凡的试飞，并为人类开启了和平、合作的深空探索的新篇章（chapter）。

sentences.en: The four astronauts of NASA's Artemis IImission safely returned to Earth on April 10, 2026, capping a historic 10-day journey around the Moon.
sentences.cn: 美国国家航空航天局“阿耳弥斯2号”太空飞行任务（mission）的四名宇航员（astronaut）于2026年4月10日安全地（safely）返回地球，结束了为期10天环绕月球（Moon）的历史性的（historic）旅程。

sentences.en: The Orion spacecraft splashed down smoothly in the Pacific Ocean, marking humanity's first crewed flight beyond low Earth orbit in more than 50 years.
sentences.cn: “猎户座”飞船（the Orion spacecraft）顺利地（smoothly）在太平洋（the Pacific Ocean）溅落，这标志着人类（humanity）50多年来首次执行离开近地轨道（low Earth orbit）的载人飞行（flight）任务。

sentences.en: Launched on April 1, the mission set a new record for the longest distance humans have ever traveled from Earth.
sentences.cn: 该任务于4月1日发射，创下了人类从地球出发后飞行（travel）距离最长的新纪录。

sentences.en: The crew looped around the far side of the Moon, observing the lunar surface and capturing breathtaking images of meteor craters, ancient landscapes, and the the lunar horizon.
sentences.cn: 机组人员（crew）环绕（loop）月球背面飞行，观测月球表面（surface），并拍摄了（capture）令人赞叹的（breathtaking）陨石坑（meteor crater）、古老地貌以及壮观的（spectacular）“地落”图像（image）一一我们的行星（planet）悬挂在月球地平线（horizon）上方。

sentences.en: During the flight, they informally named a small crater near the lunar limb "Carroll" in memory of the commander's late wife.
sentences.cn: 飞行期间，他们非正式地（informally）将靠近月球边缘（limb）的一个小陨石坑命名为“卡罗尔”，以纪念指挥官（commander）已故的（late）妻子。

sentences.en: The mission took its name Artemis from the Greek goddess of the Moon, the twin sister of Apollo, establishing a clear link to NASA's classic Apollo lunar program.
sentences.cn: 该任务以希腊的（Greek）月亮女神阿耳忒弥斯，阿波罗的双胞胎（twin）姐妹的名字命名，这与NASA经典的（classic）阿波罗探月计划（program）建立了明确的联系（link）。

sentences.en: The Orion spacecraft was named after a well-known constellation, representing humanity's drive to explore outer space.
sentences.cn: “猎户座”飞船是以一个有名的（well-know）星座（constellation）命名的，象征（represent）着人类探索外太空（outer space）的不解追求。

sentences.en: As a milestone in global space exploration, Artemis II carries deep and universal significance for humankind.
sentences.cn: 作为全球太空探索（exploration）的一个里程碑（milestone），阿耳忒弥斯2号对人类具有深远且普遍的（universal）意义。

sentences.en: The international crew demonstrated the power of cooperation in exploring the universe.
sentences.cn: 国际机组人员证明（demonstrate）了人类探索宇宙（universe）合作（cooperation）的力量。

sentences.en: The mission tested key systems of the Orion spacecraft including life support, heat shields, and deep- space navigation providing invaluable data for future lunar exploration and potential missions to Mars.
sentences.cn: 此次任务测试了“猎户座”飞船的关键系统，包括生命维持、隔热罩和深空导航（navigation），为未来的月球探索以及潜在的（potential）火星（Mars）任务提供了极其珍贵的（invaluable）数据（data）。

sentences.en: The vivid images recorded during the flight also revealed the beauty of the solar system, arousing public interest and inspiring young people to pursue science and technology.
sentences.cn: 飞行过程中拍摄的生动图像也展现了太阳系（solar system）的美丽，引起（arouse）了公众的（public）兴趣，并激励了年轻人投身于科学和技术领域。

sentences.en: With its successful completion, Artemis II completed a remarkable test flight and opened a new for humanity.
sentences.cn: 随着（with）此次任务的成功完成（completion），阿耳忒弥斯2号完成了一次非凡的试飞，并为人类开启了和平、合作的深空探索的新篇章（chapter）。

readings.title: A Safe Evacuation
readings.text: On December 10, 2025, a fatal landslide happened in Huangci Village, Gansu Province. Earth and rocks rolled down the mountain and buried 39 houses, causing substantial e economic losses. Fortunately, for the villagers, no one was injured. All 378 people had left their homes safely in time. How did they make it? A villager was strolling near the mountain that morning. He witnessed the earth sliding down the slope. He knew it was dangerous, so he ran to tell the village leaders at once. The leaders responded promptly. They alerted the villagers and told them to evacuate quickly. In only one hour, everybody got out of the dangerous area. Later, 120 families were relocated to safe places. Disasters like floods and landslides often come relocate abruptly. But we can keep ourselves safe if we adhere to some simple rules. First, watch for small danger earth. Second, signs around us, like the unstable listen to adults and do as they say without delay when there is a warning. Third, help each other. When we work together, we are more resilient and safer. The landslide incident in Gansu is a great example of these rules working effectively. It imparts meaningful lesson to us-Being careful and speaking up can save lives when we see danger. Let's remember these crucial principles in our daily life, and disseminate them among our intimates, for they will aid us in staying safe in tough times. Ultimately, life is our most precious asset, and safety should never be taken for granted. In the face of unpredictable natural disasters, public awareness and defence. collective responsibility act as our ultimate By equipping ourselves with essential survival skills and maintaining constant vigilance, we can build a solid fortress against potential dangers. Let us take proactive measures today, ensuring that whenever a crisis strikes, we are fully prepared to protect ourselves and those we cherish.
readings.translation: 2025年12月10日，甘肃黄茨村发生（happen）了一场致命的（fatal）山体滑坡（landslide）。泥土（earth）和岩石从山上滚落下来，掩埋（bury）了39座房屋，并造成了重大的（substantial）经济（economic）损失。幸运的是，对村民们（villager）来说，没有人受伤。所有378名村民及时安全地撤离了他们的家园。他们是如何成功做到的呢？那天早上，一位村民在山边散步（stroll），他目睹（witness）了泥土从山坡（slope）上滑落。他知道这很危险（dangerous），于是立刻跑去告诉了村里的领导们（leader）。领导们迅速地（promptly）作出反应（respond）。他们警示（alert）村民，并让他们迅速撤离（evacuate）。仅仅一个小时后，每个人（everybody）都从危险区域（area）撤离了。后来，120户家庭被重新安置（relocate）到了安全的地方。像洪水和山体滑坡这样的灾难（disaster）往往突然地（abruptly）来临。但如果我们遵循（adhere）一些简单的（simple）规则，就能保护自己。首先，留意我们周围的小危险（danger）迹象，比如不稳定的（unstable）泥土。其次，接到预警（warning）后，要听从大人的指挥，立即（without delay）按照他们说的去做。第三，互相帮助。当我们一起合作时，我们会更有适应力（resilient）、更安全。甘肃的这次山体滑坡事件（incident）就是这些规则有效地（effectively）发挥作用的一个很好的例子。它给我们上（impart）了一堂重要的（meaningful）课一一当我们察觉到危险时，保持警惕并大胆说出来（speak up），能够拯救生命。让我们在日常生活中牢记这些至关重要的原则（principle），并将其分享（disseminate）给我们的密友（intimate），因为它们能帮助（aid）我们在艰难（tough）时刻保持安全。最终，生命是我们最宝贵的财产（asset），安全绝不应该被认为是理所当然的。面对不可预知的（unpredictable）自然（natural）灾难，公众意识和集体（collective）责任（responsibility）是我们的最终（ultimate）防御措施（defence）。通过掌握必要的生存技能并时刻保持警觉（vigilance），我们可以建立起抵御潜在危险的坚实的（solid）堡垒（fortress）。让我们今天就采取积极主动的（proactive）措施（measure），确保每当危机（crisis）来袭时，我们都做好充分准备（prepared），来保护自己和所珍视的人。灾害防范与宇宙探索

sentences.en: On December 10, 2025, a fatal landslide happened in Huangci Village, Gansu Province.
sentences.cn: 2025年12月10日，甘肃黄茨村发生（happen）了一场致命的（fatal）山体滑坡（landslide）。

sentences.en: Earth and rocks rolled down the mountain and buried 39 houses, causing substantial e economic losses.
sentences.cn: 泥土（earth）和岩石从山上滚落下来，掩埋（bury）了39座房屋，并造成了重大的（substantial）经济（economic）损失。

sentences.en: Fortunately, for the villagers, no one was injured.
sentences.cn: 幸运的是，对村民们（villager）来说，没有人受伤。

sentences.en: All 378 people had left their homes safely in time.
sentences.cn: 所有378名村民及时安全地撤离了他们的家园。

sentences.en: How did they make it?
sentences.cn: 他们是如何成功做到的呢？

sentences.en: A villager was strolling near the mountain that morning. He witnessed the earth sliding down the slope.
sentences.cn: 那天早上，一位村民在山边散步（stroll），他目睹（witness）了泥土从山坡（slope）上滑落。

sentences.en: He knew it was dangerous, so he ran to tell the village leaders at once.
sentences.cn: 他知道这很危险（dangerous），于是立刻跑去告诉了村里的领导们（leader）。

sentences.en: The leaders responded promptly.
sentences.cn: 领导们迅速地（promptly）作出反应（respond）。

sentences.en: They alerted the villagers and told them to evacuate quickly.
sentences.cn: 他们警示（alert）村民，并让他们迅速撤离（evacuate）。

sentences.en: In only one hour, everybody got out of the dangerous area.
sentences.cn: 仅仅一个小时后，每个人（everybody）都从危险区域（area）撤离了。

sentences.en: Later, 120 families were relocated to safe places.
sentences.cn: 后来，120户家庭被重新安置（relocate）到了安全的地方。

sentences.en: Disasters like floods and landslides often come relocate abruptly.
sentences.cn: 像洪水和山体滑坡这样的灾难（disaster）往往突然地（abruptly）来临。

sentences.en: But we can keep ourselves safe if we adhere to some simple rules.
sentences.cn: 但如果我们遵循（adhere）一些简单的（simple）规则，就能保护自己。

sentences.en: First, watch for small danger earth. Second, signs around us, like the unstable listen to adults and do as they say without delay when there is a warning.
sentences.cn: 首先，留意我们周围的小危险（danger）迹象，比如不稳定的（unstable）泥土。其次，接到预警（warning）后，要听从大人的指挥，立即（without delay）按照他们说的去做。

sentences.en: Third, help each other.
sentences.cn: 第三，互相帮助。

sentences.en: When we work together, we are more resilient and safer.
sentences.cn: 当我们一起合作时，我们会更有适应力（resilient）、更安全。

sentences.en: The landslide incident in Gansu is a great example of these rules working effectively.
sentences.cn: 甘肃的这次山体滑坡事件（incident）就是这些规则有效地（effectively）发挥作用的一个很好的例子。

sentences.en: It imparts meaningful lesson to us-Being careful and speaking up can save lives when we see danger.
sentences.cn: 它给我们上（impart）了一堂重要的（meaningful）课一一当我们察觉到危险时，保持警惕并大胆说出来（speak up），能够拯救生命。

sentences.en: Let's remember these crucial principles in our daily life, and disseminate them among our intimates, for they will aid us in staying safe in tough times.
sentences.cn: 让我们在日常生活中牢记这些至关重要的原则（principle），并将其分享（disseminate）给我们的密友（intimate），因为它们能帮助（aid）我们在艰难（tough）时刻保持安全。

sentences.en: Ultimately, life is our most precious asset, and safety should never be taken for granted.
sentences.cn: 最终，生命是我们最宝贵的财产（asset），安全绝不应该被认为是理所当然的。

sentences.en: In the face of unpredictable natural disasters, public awareness and defence. collective responsibility act as our ultimate By equipping ourselves with essential survival skills and maintaining constant vigilance, we can build a solid fortress against potential dangers.
sentences.cn: 面对不可预知的（unpredictable）自然（natural）灾难，公众意识和集体（collective）责任（responsibility）是我们的最终（ultimate）防御措施（defence）。通过掌握必要的生存技能并时刻保持警觉（vigilance），我们可以建立起抵御潜在危险的坚实的（solid）堡垒（fortress）。

sentences.en: Let us take proactive measures today, ensuring that whenever a crisis strikes, we are fully prepared to protect ourselves and those we cherish.
sentences.cn: 让我们今天就采取积极主动的（proactive）措施（measure），确保每当危机（crisis）来袭时，我们都做好充分准备（prepared），来保护自己和所珍视的人。

readings.title: The Alberta Hail Project
readings.titleCn: 阿尔伯塔冰雹研究项目
readings.text: On September 7, 1991, the costliest hailstorm in Canadian history hit Calgary's southern suburbs. As a result, since 1996 a group of insurance companies have spent about $2 million per year on the Alberta Hail Suppression Project. Planes seed threatening s storm cells with a chemical to make small ice crystals fall as rain before they can grow into dangerous hailstones. But farmers in east-central Alberta-downwind of the hail project flights worry that precious moisture is being stolen from their thirsty land by cloud seeding. Norman Stienwand, who farms in that area, has been addressing public meetings on this issue for years. “Basically, the provincial government gives permission to the insurance companies to protect the Calgary-Edmonton urban zone from hail," Mr Stienwand says, “but they're simultaneously heightening drought risks as far east as Saskatchewan." The Alberta Hail Project is managed by Terry Krauss, a cloud physicist who works for Weather Modification Inc. of Fargo, North Dakota. “"We affect merely a very small percentage of the total moisture in the air, so drought cannot be triggered by our wetter operations, Dr Krauss says. "On the contrary, ground conditions brought by our work actually increase moisture downwind." One doubter about the safety of cloud seeding is Chuck Doswell, a research scientist who has just retired from the University of Oklahoma. “In 1999, I personally saw severe tornadoes form from a seeded storm cell in Kansas," Dr Doswell says. “Does cloud seeding create destructive storms or lessen downwind? No one really knows, of course, moisture but the seeding goes on." Given the degree of doubt, Mr Stienwand suggests, “It would be sensible to halt cloud seeding." In practice, doubt has had the opposite effect. Owing to the lack of scientific proof concerning the impacts of cloud seeding, no one has succeeded in winning a lawsuit against cloud-seeding companies. Therefore, private climate engineering can proceed with relative legal safety. People still hold conflicting views on whether cloud-seeding projects are good or bad. Thus, more long-term scientific research is urgently needed to standardize climate-engineering practices. sno-
readings.translation: 1991年9月（September）7日，加拿大历史上损失最为惨重的（costly）大霓灾袭击了（hit）卡尔加里南部的（southern）郊区（suburb）。自1996年以来，一批保险（insurance）公司每年在艾伯塔防電项目（the Alberta Hail Suppression Project）上投入约200万美元。飞机（plane）向可能具有威胁性的（threatening）风暴单体（storm cell）撒（seed）一种化学物质，以使小冰晶（crystal）在变成危险的（dangerous）電块（hailstone）之前先以雨水的形式降落。但艾伯塔省中东部（east-central）地区的农民（farmer）一—位于冰霓项目飞行路线的下风处（downwind）一一担心宝贵的水分（moisture）正被人工增雨（cloud seeding）从他们千旱的（thirsty）土地中偷走（steal）。诺曼·斯蒂恩万德在该地区（area）务农（farm），多年来他一直在公开会议（meeting）上就这个争论的问题（issue）发表演说。斯蒂恩万德先生说：“基本上（basically），省（provincial）政府准许（permission）保险公司对卡尔加里一一埃德蒙顿的城区（urban zone）实施防電保护措施，但同时（simultaneously），他们增加（heighten）了远至萨斯喀彻温省东部地区的千旱（drought）风险。”艾伯塔省的防電项目由特里·克劳斯管理（manage），他是一位云物理学家（physicist），为北达科他州法戈市的气象改造公司工作（work）。克劳斯博士表示：“我们只（merely）影响了空气中总（total）水分的极小的百分比（percentage）因此我们的操作（operation）不会引发（trigger）干旱。恰恰相反（on the contrary），我们所开展的工作带来的更湿润的（wet）地面条件（condition）实际上会增加（increase）下风处的湿度。”人工增雨安全性的质疑者（doubter）之一是查克·多斯韦尔，一位刚刚从俄克拉荷马大学退休（retire）的研究科学家（scientist）。多斯韦尔博士说：“1999年，我亲眼（personally）看到了一场撒过化学物质的风暴单体在堪萨斯州形成了严重的龙卷风（tornado）。人工增雨究竞是会制造出破坏性的（destructive）风暴，还是会减少（lessen）下风处的水分呢？当然，没人能确切知道，但这项作业仍在继续（goon）。”鉴于存在诸多质疑（given the degree of doubt），斯蒂恩万德先生建议：“停止（halt）人工增雨是明智的（sensible）。"但实际上，这种质疑却产生了相反的效果。由于（owing to）缺乏（lack）关于人工增雨影响的科学证明（proof），没有人能够成功赢得与人工增雨公司的官司（lawsuit）。因此，私营的（private）气候工程（engineering）在相对（relative）法律安全的环境下继续进行（proceed）。人们对于人工增雨项目是好是坏仍持有相矛盾的（conflicting）观点，因此，迫切（urgently）需要开展更多长期的科学研究，以使气候工程的实践操作标准化（standardize）。

sentences.en: On September 7, 1991, the costliest hailstorm in Canadian history hit Calgary's southern suburbs.
sentences.cn: 1991年9月（September）7日，加拿大历史上损失最为惨重的（costly）大霓灾袭击了（hit）卡尔加里南部的（southern）郊区（suburb）。

sentences.en: As a result, since 1996 a group of insurance companies have spent about $2 million per year on the Alberta Hail Suppression Project.
sentences.cn: 自1996年以来，一批保险（insurance）公司每年在艾伯塔防電项目（the Alberta Hail Suppression Project）上投入约200万美元。

sentences.en: Planes seed threatening s storm cells with a chemical to make small ice crystals fall as rain before they can grow into dangerous hailstones.
sentences.cn: 飞机（plane）向可能具有威胁性的（threatening）风暴单体（storm cell）撒（seed）一种化学物质，以使小冰晶（crystal）在变成危险的（dangerous）電块（hailstone）之前先以雨水的形式降落。

sentences.en: But farmers in east-central Alberta-downwind of the hail project flights worry that precious moisture is being stolen from their thirsty land by cloud seeding.
sentences.cn: 但艾伯塔省中东部（east-central）地区的农民（farmer）一—位于冰霓项目飞行路线的下风处（downwind）一一担心宝贵的水分（moisture）正被人工增雨（cloud seeding）从他们千旱的（thirsty）土地中偷走（steal）。

sentences.en: Norman Stienwand, who farms in that area, has been addressing public meetings on this issue for years.
sentences.cn: 诺曼·斯蒂恩万德在该地区（area）务农（farm），多年来他一直在公开会议（meeting）上就这个争论的问题（issue）发表演说。

sentences.en: “Basically, the provincial government gives permission to the insurance companies to protect the Calgary-Edmonton urban zone from hail," Mr Stienwand says, “but they're simultaneously heightening drought risks as far east as Saskatchewan."
sentences.cn: 斯蒂恩万德先生说：“基本上（basically），省（provincial）政府准许（permission）保险公司对卡尔加里一一埃德蒙顿的城区（urban zone）实施防電保护措施，但同时（simultaneously），他们增加（heighten）了远至萨斯喀彻温省东部地区的千旱（drought）风险。”

sentences.en: The Alberta Hail Project is managed by Terry Krauss, a cloud physicist who works for Weather Modification Inc. of Fargo, North Dakota.
sentences.cn: 艾伯塔省的防電项目由特里·克劳斯管理（manage），他是一位云物理学家（physicist），为北达科他州法戈市的气象改造公司工作（work）。

sentences.en: “"We affect merely a very small percentage of the total moisture in the air, so drought cannot be triggered by our wetter operations, Dr Krauss says.
sentences.cn: 克劳斯博士表示：“我们只（merely）影响了空气中总（total）水分的极小的百分比（percentage）因此我们的操作（operation）不会引发（trigger）干旱。

sentences.en: "On the contrary, ground conditions brought by our work actually increase moisture downwind."
sentences.cn: 恰恰相反（on the contrary），我们所开展的工作带来的更湿润的（wet）地面条件（condition）实际上会增加（increase）下风处的湿度。”

sentences.en: One doubter about the safety of cloud seeding is Chuck Doswell, a research scientist who has just retired from the University of Oklahoma.
sentences.cn: 人工增雨安全性的质疑者（doubter）之一是查克·多斯韦尔，一位刚刚从俄克拉荷马大学退休（retire）的研究科学家（scientist）。

sentences.en: “In 1999, I personally saw severe tornadoes form from a seeded storm cell in Kansas," Dr Doswell says.
sentences.cn: 多斯韦尔博士说：“1999年，我亲眼（personally）看到了一场撒过化学物质的风暴单体在堪萨斯州形成了严重的龙卷风（tornado）。

sentences.en: “Does cloud seeding create destructive storms or lessen downwind? No one really knows, of course, moisture but the seeding goes on."
sentences.cn: 人工增雨究竞是会制造出破坏性的（destructive）风暴，还是会减少（lessen）下风处的水分呢？

sentences.en: Given the degree of doubt, Mr Stienwand suggests, “It would be sensible to halt cloud seeding."
sentences.cn: 当然，没人能确切知道，但这项作业仍在继续（goon）。”鉴于存在诸多质疑（given the degree of doubt），斯蒂恩万德先生建议：“停止（halt）人工增雨是明智的（sensible）。"

sentences.en: In practice, doubt has had the opposite effect.
sentences.cn: 但实际上，这种质疑却产生了相反的效果。

sentences.en: Owing to the lack of scientific proof concerning the impacts of cloud seeding, no one has succeeded in winning a lawsuit against cloud-seeding companies.
sentences.cn: 由于（owing to）缺乏（lack）关于人工增雨影响的科学证明（proof），没有人能够成功赢得与人工增雨公司的官司（lawsuit）。

sentences.en: Therefore, private climate engineering can proceed with relative legal safety.
sentences.cn: 因此，私营的（private）气候工程（engineering）在相对（relative）法律安全的环境下继续进行（proceed）。

sentences.en: People still hold conflicting views on whether cloud-seeding projects are good or bad. Thus, more long-term scientific research is urgently needed to standardize climate-engineering practices. sno-
sentences.cn: 人们对于人工增雨项目是好是坏仍持有相矛盾的（conflicting）观点，因此，迫切（urgently）需要开展更多长期的科学研究，以使气候工程的实践操作标准化（standardize）。

readings.title: The Cognition of the Universe
readings.text: The notion that we live in someone else's video game is irresistible to many. Searching the term "simulation hypothesis" brings up a wealth of discussion that discusses whether the universe is a computer simulationa concept that some scientists actually take seriously. Regrettably, this is not a scientific question. We will probably never confirm its authenticity. We can, instead, use this idea to advance scientific knowledge. The 18th-century philosopher Kant argued that the universe e ultimately consists of things-in-themselves that are unknowable. While he held the notion of the existence of objective reality, he said our mind plays an essential role in structuring and shaping our perceptions. Modern sciences have revealed that our perceptual experience of the world is the result of many stages of processing by sensory systems and cognitive functions in the brain. The inner workings of this unknown black box remain unclear to people. If empirical experience fails to expose reality, logical reasoning won't reveal reality either since it relies on conceptions and unclear un + clear words that are contingent on our social, cultural and psychological backgrounds. Again, a black box. So, if we approve of the idea that the universe is unknowable, we also accept that we will never know if we live in a computer simulation. Accordingly, we can shift our inquiry from “Is the universe a computer simulation?" to “Can we model the u universe as a simulation?" reality is what we Constructingr computer do. To facilitate our comprehension of the world, we build models based on conceptual metaphors that are conventional to us. In Newton's era, we conceived of the universe as a mechanical clock. In Einstein's time, we uncovered the standard model of particle physics. Presently, we are in the information age, where we have new concepts such as the computer, information processing, virtual reality, and simulation. concepts inspire us to Unsurprisingly, these emerging build new models of the universe. Models are not the reality, however. There is no point in disputing whether the universe is a clock, a set of particles or an output of computation. All these models are tools to deal with the unknown and to make discoveries. The more tools swe own, the more effective and insightful we can become. It can be imagined that, comparable to the process of building previous scientific models, developing the "computer simulation"metaphor-based model will also be of extreme value. un-
readings.translation: 许多人都难以抗拒（irresistible）这样一种想法（notion）：我们生活在某人的电子游戏之中。搜索“模拟（simulation）假说（hypothesis）”这一术语（term），会出现大量（awe al thof）关于宇宙（universe）是否是一种计算机（computer）模拟的讨论（discuss）一些科学家真的认真（seriously）对待这一概念（concept）。遗憾的是（regrettably），这并非一个科学（scientific）问题。我们或许永远无法（never）证实（confirm）其真实性（authenticity）。不过，我们可以利用这一想法来推进科学知识的发展。18世纪的哲学家（philosopher）康德认为，宇宙本质上是由不可知的（unknowable）“物自体”所构成的。尽管他认同客观现实（reality）存在（existence）的观点，但他也指出，我们的思维在构建和塑造我们的感知（perception）中起着至关重要的（essential）作用。现代科学已经揭示（reveal），我们对世界的感知（perceptual）体验是大脑中的感觉系统（sensory system）和认知功能（cognitive function）经过多个阶段（stage）处理的结果。这个未知的（unknown）“黑匣子（black box）”的内部运作机制对于人们来说仍然是不清楚的（unclear）。如果（if）实证（empirical）经验无法揭示（expose）现实，那么逻辑（logical）推理也无法揭示现实，因为逻辑推理依托的概念（conception）和语言取决于（contingent on）我们的社会、文化和心理背景（background）。这又是一个“黑匾子”。因此（so），如果我们赞成（approve）宇宙是不可知的，我们也就接受了自己永远不知道是否生活在计算机模拟中。因为一种计算机模拟？”构建（construct）现实就是我们的工作。为了促进（facilitate）对这个世界的理解（comprehension），我们基于对我们来说惯例的（conventional）概念（conceptual）隐喻（metaphor）来构建模型。在牛顿的时代（era），我们将宇宙构想（conceive）为一个机械的（mechanical）时钟。在爱因斯坦的时代，我们发现了（uncover）粒子（particle）物理学（physics）的标准模型。现在（presently），我们身处信息时代，我们有了诸如计算机、信息处理、虚拟（virtual）现实和模拟等新概念。不足为奇的是（unsurprisingly），这些新兴的（emerging）概念激发我们去构建新的宇宙模型。然而，模型不是现实。争论（dispute）宇宙究竞是一个时钟、一组粒子还是一次计算（computation）的输出（output）是毫无意义的。所有这些模型都是用于应对未知的事物并取得发现discovery）的工具（tool)。我们拥有（own）的工具越多，我们就能变得越高效、越富有洞察力（insightful）。可以想象，与以往（previous）构建科学模型的过程类似（comparable），开发这种基于“计算机模拟”隐喻的模型也将具有极大的（extreme）价值。

sentences.en: The notion that we live in someone else's video game is irresistible to many.

sentences.en: Modern sciences have revealed that our perceptual experience of the world is the result of many stages of processing by sensory systems and cognitive functions in the brain.
sentences.cn: 现代科学已经揭示（reveal），我们对世界的感知（perceptual）体验是大脑中的感觉系统（sensory system）和认知功能（cognitive function）经过多个阶段（stage）处理的结果。

readings.title: A Trip to the Desert 沙漠之旅
readings.text: This is a dry, hot day. Mom says, “We will not have lunch by the sea; today we visit a desert.” Many people come with us. At first, I feel a thin chain knocking my ear. Does it hurt? “No, be careful,” says a kind person. A girl in a pink skirt can skate anywhere. She can catch juice with a cup! What a funny trick. After dinner, we play games and eat pancakes. My parents want to be writers, so I write a story in my pencil-box book every hour. Tomorrow I will wear my new trousers. This trip is not a diet — we eat a lot and laugh a lot. What a happy day!
readings.translation: 这是一个干燥炎热的日子。妈妈说：“我们不在海边吃午饭，今天我们去参观沙漠。”很多人都和我们一起去。起初，一条细细的链子敲到我的耳朵。它疼吗？“不疼，要小心。”一位善良的人说。一个穿粉色裙子的女孩能在任何地方滑冰。她还能用杯子接住果汁！真是个好玩的把戏。晚饭后，我们做游戏、吃薄饼。我的父母想当作家，所以我每小时都在铅笔盒书里写一个故事。明天我要穿我的新裤子。这次旅行可不是节食——我们吃了很多，笑得很开心。多么快乐的一天！

readings.title: A Picnic with Uncle 和叔叔去野餐
readings.text: Today I go to the playground with my uncle. We see a dog near the pond. The dog can carry a doll in its mouth! We watch it and laugh. Then we eat a picnic lunch on the grass. I take a picture of the dog with my pencil drawing. At night, we sleep in the house. My uncle is a doctor, not a worker. He says, “I work hard and I can achieve anything on time.” We sit on a chair and talk together. He puts a small pill into my hand and says, “This is for a sick bird. Put it into the pond? No, into the bird!” We laugh again. Sixty minutes pass. Friendship is like a warm umbrella. Goodbye, dog!
readings.translation: 今天我和叔叔一起去操场。我们看见池塘边有一只狗。那只狗能用嘴叼着一个洋娃娃！我们看着它，哈哈大笑。然后我们在草地上吃野餐。我用铅笔画画，给狗拍照。晚上，我们在房子里睡觉。我叔叔是医生，不是工人。他说：“我努力工作，就能按时完成任何事情。”我们坐在椅子上一起聊天。他把一颗小药丸放进我手里说：“这是给一只生病的小鸟的。放进池塘里？不，放进小鸟嘴里！”我们又笑了。六十分钟过去了。友谊就像一把温暖的雨伞。再见，小狗！

readings.title: A Happy Birthday 开心的生日
readings.text: Am I seven? No, I am six now. On my birthday, I sat in a dark room and waited. Then Dad came home. He told me, “Happy birthday, dear!” He played a song on his drum, and I danced. We ate two eggs and a pear, and drank some water. The candy was sweet, and the soup was hot. A clown at the door laughed and gave me a new chair. I passed him a cookie and said thank you. I learned to count: one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten! At night I slept early, twice I woke up, but I was happy. The worker at the airport helped us, and we planted a little tree on foot. I answered all the questions on the blackboard. What a wonderful day!

readings.title: An Octopus and a Camel 章鱼和骆驼
readings.text: An octopus and a camel met one day. “Can you hop?” asked the camel. “No, but I can swim,” said the octopus. They hoped to play together. It was July, and the popcorn was ready. “Please take a seat on this old chair,” said the octopus. They ate and watched TV. The camel wore a crown and looked like a king. “Do not shout; please wish me good luck,” said the camel. The octopus believed in him and gave him a little flag. It was eight o’clock, and the moon rose. The camel left for the palace. The octopus said, “I will miss you.” Another year passed. They met again in October. What a lot of fun they had! They both learned to slide down the hill. I think they read books about it too.

readings.title: The Little Bunny 小兔子
readings.text: As the sun went down, a little bunny ran out. It was cool and windy. The bunny could jump far and draw a hill with its foot. It saw a park with a small post office. “What’s the matter?” asked a policeman. “I lost my crayon,” said the bunny. “Don’t worry, we can find it,” said a girl. They looked everywhere: near the tree, under the bench, behind the bus. At last, the girl found a yellow crayon in the snow. The bunny was happy and jumped high. It was only eight o’clock, but the bunny was tired. “Good night,” said everyone. The next afternoon, the bunny remembered the kind girl and smiled. A little help makes a big difference. Nothing is too hard if you try!

readings.title: The Clever Cook 聪明的厨师
readings.text: At six o’clock, a clever cook drew a big red tree on the wall. “Look!” cried his cousin. “Your drawing is so good!” The cook laughed. “I paid for this brush,” he said. “Now let’s cook something.” They made chips and salad. The cook tested the soup: it was too salty. “We can fix it,” he said. He put a little sugar in it. His cousin opened the window to let fresh air in. A hungry cat came in and smelt the fish. “Go away, cat!” shouted the cook. But the cat just sat next to them. They all laughed. “I like this smart cat,” said the cook. He gave the cat a small piece of meat. At last, they washed the dishes together. The cook was proud. “Teamwork makes us strong,” he said. Confidence is important in the kitchen!
readings.translation: 六点钟，一位聪明的厨师在墙上画了一棵红色大树。“看！”他的表弟喊道。“你画得真好！”厨师笑了。“这支画笔是我花钱买的。”他说。“现在我们来做点吃的吧。”他们做了薯条和沙拉。厨师尝了尝汤：太咸了。“我们能补救。”他说着放了一点糖进去。表弟打开窗户让新鲜空气进来。一只饥饿的猫进来闻到了鱼味。“走开，猫！”厨师喊道。可猫只是坐在他们旁边。大家都笑了。“我喜欢这只聪明的猫。”厨师说着给了猫一小块肉。最后，他们一起洗碗。厨师很自豪：“团队合作让我们更强大。”在厨房里，自信很重要！

readings.title: The Gray Whale 灰色鲸鱼
readings.text: Be careful! A big gray whale is swimming in the sea. It came from a far place. The whale wore a brown hat and looked very funny. It was heavy and slow, but it could run fast in the water. “Come here!” I shouted. The whale came over and looked at me. It chose to stay with us for one day. We gave it some milk and bread. It helped us carry a heavy box. The whale lived near the beach. At last, it said goodbye and went home. I felt a little sad, but I was not afraid. I hope to see it again. This whale is my best friend. Its home is the blue sea. I will never forget this day. What a wonderful animal!
readings.translation: 小心！一只大灰鲸正在海里游泳。它来自很远的地方。鲸鱼戴着一顶棕色的帽子，看起来很好笑。它又重又慢，但在水里能游得很快。“过来！”我喊道。鲸鱼游了过来，看着我。它选择和我们待一天。我们给它一些牛奶和面包。它帮我们搬了一个重箱子。鲸鱼住在海滩附近。最后，它说了再见就回家了。我有点难过，但并不害怕。我希望再见到它。这只鲸鱼是我最好的朋友。它的家是蓝色的大海。我永远不会忘记这一天。多么神奇的动物！

readings.title: The Strawberry and the Cat 草莓和猫
readings.text: Do you like strawberries? I do. One day, a white cat put a strawberry in its mouth. “Please do not eat it!” I said. The cat kept the strawberry and ran away. I helped my mum cook dinner. We made some soup and bread. I heard a knock at the door. It was the cat again! It brought me a purple flower. “Thank you,” I said with a smile. The cat was very clever. It could count to five! I combed its hair and gave it some milk. We played together in the morning. The cat liked the balloon very much. I wanted to keep it, but the cat had a home. At school, I told my classmates about the cat. They all laughed. The weather was sunny and warm. What a lovely day with my little friend!

readings.title: Grandpa’s Cold 爷爷的感冒
readings.text: Go to the taxi, please. My grandpa has a cold today. He is very sad. “Don’t worry,” I say. “Let’s go to the hospital.” In the car, grandpa feels cold and tired. He coughs and coughs. We wait for a long time. The doctor gives him a bandage and some medicine. “You should rest,” the doctor says. We go home and I make warm soup for him. Grandpa smiles and says, “You are my sunshine.” We share a big lunch together. Then I clean the room and wash the dishes. At night, grandpa puts on his coat. “I feel better now,” he says. We watch the beautiful rainbow in the sky. What a lovely weekend! I love my grandpa very much.

readings.title: The Brave Policeman 勇敢的警察
readings.text: He is a policeman. He can fly a plane, but today he rides a bike. He is very brave. One day, he saw a fire in a shop. “Help! Help!” a woman cried. The policeman ran into the shop. He used a torch to see in the dark. He saved a cat and a baby. “Thank you,” the woman said. “You are a hero.” The policeman smiled. “It is my job,” he said. At noon, he drank some cola and ate some rice. He watched the weather on TV. “Tomorrow will be sunny,” the TV said. The policeman got a medal from the people. Everyone in the town knew him. He felt happy because he could help others. He said, “Kindness is the best gift.” What a good man he is!

readings.title: A Walk in the Fog 雾中漫步
readings.text: Hi! It is a foggy day. My father and I walk in the woods. “Turn right,” he says. We climb a small hill. It is snowy on the top. We sit on a coat and drink hot tea. “Are you bored?” I ask. “No, it is easy to be happy here,” he says. We wait because we want to see a rabbit. After ninety minutes, somebody comes — a white rabbit! It is so wonderful. We play a little game and score five points. The rabbit smiles and shows its white tooth. A butterfly kisses a flower. The weather is cloudy, but we feel okay and rich with joy. We ring the doorbell at home and listen to music. I respect my father very much. Bye, rabbit! What a nice morning!

readings.title: A Kite in the City 城市里的风筝
readings.text: If the weather is fine, we can fly a kite in the city. I buy a black kite for ten yuan. It is really great! My sister has a white one. “Take my hand,” she says. The wind is strong, and the kite flies high over the wall. We run and laugh. At noon, we eat a big dumpling. I feel a little tired, so I close my eyes on the bench. My sister puts a scarf on my neck. “Today is Wednesday,” she says, “but we do not have class. Let’s go to the valley!” We ride on a bus. In the valley, we see a black clock on a stone. “Wow!” I say. I really like this day. My fingers are cold, but my heart is warm. You’re welcome, city! We will come again.

readings.title: The Clever Fox and the Cave 聪明的狐狸和山洞
readings.text: In the forest, a clever fox finds a cave. It is dark and hard to see inside. “I can swim,” the fox says, “but I cannot fly. Who can help me?” The fox is very clever. It uses a long rope to climb down. Inside the cave, it finds a treasure box. The box is heavy. “I must be careful,” the fox thinks. It is tired, but it does not give up. It pulls the box out with its strong teeth. Twenty minutes later, the fox is outside. It opens the box: there is a golden medal! The fox smiles. “Hard work always wins,” it says. The other animals laugh and clap. They learn a good lesson from the clever fox. Watermelon? No, the fox gives them fresh fruit instead!

readings.title: A Day at the Circus 马戏团的一天
readings.text: It is sunny. My mother and I take a bus to the circus. We are so excited! A tiger can jump through a ring. An elephant can paint a flower with its nose. “What about a lion?” I ask. A clown gives me a card with a grape on it. We eat a big salad and spend an hour there. I meet a boy from a small village. He knows many magic tricks! We ride a little train together. He tells me, “A true friend is like a warm blanket.” On the way home, I buy a blue scarf. I am twelve years old now, and this is the best day. In the evening, I write about it in my notebook. I will never forget this happy trip!

readings.title: The Monkey’s Riddle 猴子的谜语
readings.text: It is a rainy day, and it is cold. A boy got an old toy from his grandpa. He is very happy. A monkey came and took the toy! The boy ran after it and fell down. “Please give it back,” he said. The monkey sat in a tree and made a funny face. The boy had an idea. He took out a banana and threw it. The monkey came down and gave back the toy. “You are a smart monkey!” the boy laughed. Then they became friends. The boy washed his hands at the beach. They played near a lake. The monkey showed him a secret tunnel in the forest. In the cinema, they watched a film about a brave lion. On Saturday, the boy rode a scooter to the engineer’s house. What a delicious cake they had! Don’t be late for the police station, they joked. What a funny day!
readings.translation: 下雨了，天气很冷。一个男孩从爷爷那里得到一件旧玩具，非常开心。一只猴子过来抢走了玩具！男孩追着它，摔倒了。“请把它还给我。”他说。猴子坐在树上做鬼脸。男孩有了主意。他拿出一根香蕉扔了过去。猴子下来还回了玩具。“你真是只聪明的猴子！”男孩笑了。然后他们成了朋友。男孩在海滩边洗了手。他们在湖边玩耍。猴子带他看了森林里一条秘密隧道。在电影院里，他们看了一部关于勇敢狮子的电影。星期六，男孩骑着滑板车去工程师家。他们吃到了多美味的蛋糕啊！他们开玩笑说：去警察局可别迟到。多么有趣的一天！

readings.title: The Lost Medal 丢失的奖章
readings.text: Me? I have a big box at home. It is my birthday cake box. This morning, I looked for my medal, but I could not find it. “Do not worry,” my brother said. “We can look for it together.” We walked to the farm. A goose met us on the road. We asked the farmer for help. He said, “I saw a shiny thing near the river.” We ran there and caught a crab! Ha, it was not the medal. At noon, we stopped and ate sandwiches. My brother gave me an envelope. I opened it: the medal was inside! “I hid it as a surprise,” he laughed. I threw the ball up and down. Then we went home. We usually do homework after that, but today we played the piano and had a great time. What a wonderful brother!

readings.title: Mr Hare’s Castle 野兔先生的城堡
readings.text: Mr Hare has a new castle on a high hill. He is not weak; he is strong and fast. One morning in April, he got up early and washed his face. “It is time for a race!” he said. He wore a grey uniform and a pair of gloves. He ran very fast. “Be careful!” a mouse cried. Mr Hare laughed, “I am never afraid!” But on the road, he fell. A farmer helped him. “Thank you,” Mr Hare said. He learned an important lesson: it is not good to show off. At night, he stayed in his castle. A cold wind came, and he coughed. “For example, I should wear a coat in winter,” he said. Everyone in the town received his letter. He is the seventh hero of the village. What a difficult but happy day!

readings.title: The Dragonfly and the Star 蜻蜓和星星
readings.text: My little sister and I went to the park on a rainy day. “Do not worry, we have umbrellas,” I said. My sister wore a red hat and a new dress. She felt very happy. We walked near the lake. A dragonfly flew over the water and said hello to us. It was so funny! “Look at its small wings,” my sister said. We watched the rainbow and counted the stars? No, it was daytime. We picked some carrots in the garden. My sister brushed her teeth and nodded her head. “Thank you for this nice day,” she said. In the evening, we went shopping and bought a mirror. Then we went home. The rain stopped, and the moon came out. My sister is only seven, but she is very brave. I love her very much.

readings.title: The King’s Crown 国王的王冠
readings.text: No, it is not a real crown. It is a paper crown for my grandma’s birthday. She is eighty years old but very healthy. We made the crown with a gold paper and some fruit. My grandma has a gray cat named Mimi. The cat is fat and lazy. It likes milk and meat. My grandpa lent me his radio. We listened to music and danced. “You are so kind!” my grandma said. She was surprised and smiled. At noon, we had a big dinner: soup, noodles and a small cake. The cat sat under the table and watched us. We gave it a tiny fish. It was so cute! My grandma stood up and said, “This is the best gift!” We took photos together. What a happy afternoon! I will never forget this day.

readings.title: Grandpa’s Camping Day 爷爷的露营日
readings.text: Of course, I love camping! Last weekend, my grandpa took me to the mountains. It was not bad; the air was fresh. We walked on the sand near a small river. Grandpa said, “Do not weep, and do not frown. Be brave!” We put up a tent and made a fire. We ate soup and rice. I drank a glass of water and felt much better. At night, we saw many stars. “Look, a shooting star!” I cried. Grandpa smiled and said, “Make a wish!” I closed my eyes and wished for a new camera. On the second day, we cleaned the campsite and started our journey home. My friend called me and asked, “Where were you?” “Nowhere special, just with grandpa,” I laughed. I love my grandpa. Progress comes little by little, but love grows big every day.
readings.translation: 当然，我爱露营！上周末，爷爷带我去山里。那里不错，空气清新。我们在小河边沙滩上散步。爷爷说：“别哭，也别皱眉。要勇敢！”我们搭起帐篷，生起火。我们喝了汤，吃了米饭。我喝了一杯水，感觉好多了。夜里，我们看到许多星星。“看，流星！”我喊道。爷爷笑着说：“许个愿吧！”我闭上眼睛，许愿要一台新相机。第二天，我们打扫了营地，开始返程。朋友打电话问我：“你去哪了？”“没去哪，就是和爷爷在一起。”我笑着说。我爱爷爷。进步一点点来，但爱每天都在长大。

readings.title: The Puppy in the Garden 花园里的小狗
readings.text: Ok, let me tell you a story. One winter morning, I saw a puppy in the garden. Its body was cold and dirty. It felt hungry and weak. “Excuse me, whose puppy are you?” I asked. It looked at me and barked. Most dogs bark, but this one sang a little! I took it home and gave it warm milk. It smelled the milk and ate it up. Thanks to my grandma, we cleaned it with a towel. The puppy finished its bath and looked very cute. Anyone would love it. My grandfather touched its head softly. “You can stay with us,” he said. Sometimes we walk in the park. The traffic light turns green, and we cross the street together. After practice, the puppy always waits for me. What a lovely friend!
readings.translation: 好，我给你们讲个故事。一个冬天的早晨，我在花园里看到一只小狗。它浑身又冷又脏，又饿又弱。“打扰一下，你是谁家的小狗？”我问。它看着我，叫了一声。大多数狗会叫，但这一只会唱歌！我把它带回家，给它喝温牛奶。它闻了闻牛奶，一口气喝光了。多亏了奶奶，我们用毛巾把它洗干净。小狗洗完澡，看起来非常可爱。谁都会喜欢它。爷爷轻轻摸了摸它的头：“你可以和我们住在一起。”有时我们在公园散步。绿灯亮了，我们一起过马路。练习结束后，小狗总是等着我。多么可爱的朋友！

readings.title: A Boat on the River 河上的小船
readings.text: On Sunday morning, my father and I went to the river. We saw a small boat on the water. “Can we go on it?” I asked. My father smiled and said yes. We got on the boat. A man with a tennis racket and a big chicken was there too. “Hello!” he said. “I am going home. I bought some fish and found a big shadow on the water.” We laughed. There was a little puppy in the boat. It drank some milk and fell asleep. “Something smells good,” I said. The man gave us some fast food. After that, we went to the football field and played. “Don’t sell your dreams,” my father said. At last, we arrived home by car. I wrote a postcard to my friend: “Today is a happy day!”

readings.title: The Artist and the Giraffe 画家和长颈鹿
readings.text: Or maybe you want to hear about the artist? The artist has a blue pen and a gold lock. He can draw anything. One day, he drew a giraffe on a stone. The giraffe looked so real that people wanted to touch it. “May I paint your picture?” the artist asked. “Yes,” the giraffe said, “but first let me eat some leaves.” It sent a message to its friends. The artist painted a beautiful picture of the giraffe and its friend. Above the picture, he wrote: “Dream big.” The giraffe was very proud. The artist sold the picture for forty yuan and bought a medal. He gave half of the money to a nurse for the sick children. What a kind artist! Their friendship grew. Fourteen people came to see the picture. The giraffe smiled and thought, “It is better to give than to receive.” A frog is not ugly.

readings.title: A Star Singer 明星歌手
readings.text: Please look at the map. This is the school. My sister is a singer, and she is famous in our town. One August day, she stood on the stage and sang a sweet song. People clapped and cheered. “Thank you!” she said. After the show, a girl came up and asked, “Can you teach me to sing?” My sister smiled and said, “Sure. First, you must get up early and practice every day.” She taught the girl to sing a happy song. The girl was so happy that she jumped and laughed. In November, the school held a party. The girl sang very well on the floor of the hall. Everyone was surprised. “You are a star!” they said. My sister cleaned her piano and played it for us. We went to bed late that night. It was a bright and happy day. I am proud of my sister!

readings.title: A Gift from the Sea 来自大海的礼物
readings.text: So, it is a hot summer day. A man and a little boy go to the zoo. The man is the boy’s uncle. “Look, a ship!” the boy says. “No, it is a big whale,” the uncle laughs. They buy five tickets and see many animals. Then they go to the store to buy some milk and a gift. The boy wants a toy ship and a pair of socks. “When you grow up, you can be a sailor,” says the uncle. They eat pizza for lunch. The boy tastes an onion and makes a funny face. “Don’t forget to brush your teeth,” says the uncle. They go to the theatre in the evening and watch a play about a brave captain. On the way home, the boy sees a guitar in a shop window. “It’s time to go home now,” says his mother. It is a wonderful day!

readings.title: The Storm and the Teacher 暴风雨和老师
readings.text: To tell you the truth, my teacher is my hero. One night, a big storm came. The wind yelled and the rain beat the window. My teacher drove to school to check the windows. On the way, he saw a tree fall and a car lose its wheel. “How low the sky looks!” he said. He called the police. Then he gave his coat to a cold child. “Take this helmet,” he said. “Be careful!” Other people also came to help. They gave food and soap to the families. In the morning, the storm stopped. The teacher smiled and said, “Together we are strong.” He taught us an important lesson: “Always help others.” We should follow his example. Nineteen students wrote him a letter. He will never be forgotten. What a great teacher!
readings.translation: 说实话，我的老师是我的英雄。一天夜里，一场大暴风雨来了。风呼啸着，雨敲打着窗户。老师开车去学校检查窗户。路上，他看到一棵树倒下，一辆汽车掉了轮子。“天空看起来多低啊！”他说。他报了警。然后他把外套给了一个冻得发抖的孩子。“戴上这顶头盔。”他说，“小心！”其他人也来帮忙。他们给受灾家庭送去食物和肥皂。早上，暴风雨停了。老师笑着说：“团结就是力量。”他给我们上了重要的一课：“永远帮助别人。”我们要以他为榜样。十九名学生给他写了一封信。他永远不会被忘记。多么好的老师！

readings.title: Auntie’s Ice Cream 阿姨的冰淇淋
readings.text: TV is fun, but playing outside is better. One day, my aunt took me to the hospital to see grandpa. On the way, we saw a panda in a truck! “How funny!” I laughed. The panda waved its leg and ate a banana. My aunt bought some food and a small gift. We went into a shop and got two ice creams. It was a hot day, and I ate mine fast. “Slow down!” my aunt said. “You will get a stomachache.” At the hospital, grandpa told us a story about a brave policeman. He taught us a game with a ball and a basket. We played and laughed. When we left, grandpa hugged me. “Come again soon,” he said. That night, I lost my sleep because I was so happy. I will never forget this day!

readings.text: Up in the woods, there is a hut. A big brown bear lives there. In spring, the bear wakes up early and looks for food. It likes honey and fish. One Sunday morning, the bear felt very hungry. It put on its old pants and went out. It saw a photo of a cake on the table. “I want to make a cake!” it said. But the bear was too lazy. It yawned and went back to bed. Suddenly, a little bird sang loudly, and the bear woke up. “Study hard, and you can do it!” the bird said. The bear became excited. It made a big cake with eggs and milk. The cake was full of sugar, and the bear felt sick! “Too much is bad,” it laughed. After school, the children came to visit. They all had a piece of cake and played ping-pong. What a funny bear!

readings.title: The Kangaroo on the Island 岛上的袋鼠
readings.text: Us kids all love stories. Let me tell you one. A kangaroo went to an island on a boat. It was ill and sad. It sat under a tree and sighed. “Why are you so sad?” asked a rabbit. “I lost my baby,” said the kangaroo. The rabbit was kind. It said, “Don’t give up. Let’s look for it together.” They looked everywhere: in the jungle, by the stream, near the volcano. At eight o’clock, it started to rain and lightning came. The baby kangaroo was cold and afraid. At last, they found it in a cave! The baby was drinking some syrup. “Thank you, my friends,” the kangaroo said. It decided to stay on the island. Now the island is their home, and every summer they have a big party. Sometimes they even go to the bank and the supermarket. Of course, they never forget their friends. What a warm story!

readings.title: Our Happy Neighbour 我们快乐的邻居
readings.text: We live in a small house. Its colour is white, and its garden is full of flowers. Our neighbour is an old man. He is seventy years old, but he is still strong and free. Every morning, he jogs in the park. One day, he made a wooden ball for me. I skipped and sang with joy. “Be kind to everyone,” he said. He taught me to play chess and to ride a bike. I enjoyed every minute with him. One evening, he wore a jacket and jumped over a small stream. “Wow!” I clapped. He smiled and said, “Age is just a number.” He wrote an email to his old friends and sent them photos. His legs are strong, and his heart is warm. He listens to music and takes photos of birds. We should all be like him: happy, active and kind. I love my neighbour very much.

readings.title: English Week 英语周
readings.text: Our English Week is great fun. It begins on Tuesday. We read poems and texts, and we even act out short plays. A student from Australia joins us. Nobody wants to miss it, and everyone is active. On the first day, we learn about chemistry — the teacher shows how steel can float! She points to a plate on the desk. The classroom is not strict; it is full of laughter. After class, we go on to the playground and fly kites. The wind is strong today, and the temperature is low, but we feel warm. Below the tall tree, a goose walks by. “Will there ever be a war?” someone asks. “No, peace is better than war,” says Miss Li, who is on duty. She tells us to connect with friends, not to fight. At present, we are learning to control our feelings. On the way home, I see a supermarket with noodles on sale. No trouble at all! I get a bowl of noodles and kiss my mum. My interest in English grows day by day. The internet is fun, but playing outside is even better. What an active day! Let the action begin!
readings.translation: 我们的英语周非常有趣。它在星期二开始。我们读诗歌和课文，甚至表演短剧。一位来自澳大利亚的同学加入了我们。没有人想错过它，每个人都很积极。第一天，我们学化学——老师演示了钢如何能浮起来！她指着桌上的盘子。课堂并不严格，充满了欢笑。课后，我们继续去操场放风筝。今天风很大，气温很低，但我们觉得温暖。在高大的树下，一只鹅走过。“会有战争吗？”有人问。“不会，和平比战争好。”值日的李老师说。她告诉我们要和朋友联系，而不是打架。目前，我们正在学习控制情绪。回家的路上，我看到一家超市的方便面在打折。一点麻烦也没有！我买了一碗面，亲了亲妈妈。我对英语的兴趣与日俱增。上网很有趣，但出去玩更好。多么积极的一天！让行动开始吧！

wordExamples: In the end, I took out my pencil and wrote down a simple rule: “Usually, success comes twice — once for the patient, and once for the confident.”

My grandparent laughed: “You are a hundred percent right. It is like an egg: the shell may be ugly, but inside there is life. Even a ruler is direct, yet the earth is never a straight line. Coal becomes a diamond only after sudden pressure.”
I nodded, and my twentieth birthday felt a little less loud, a little more wise.
Now I keep that magazine article on my desk, ready for college and for every everyday task.
On our school trip, the guide will introduce us to a big watermelon farm, and I hope nobody will be late for the bus.
I try to get along with everyone, and I never hate anyone.

readings.title: Grandfather’s Birthday 爷爷的生日
readings.text: My grandfather is ninety years old. On his birthday, we celebrate with chocolate cake. He sits on the stairs and tells us stories. “I was an officer in the army,” he says. “Once, I had to cross a river at night. The plan was simple: we planted a flag on the beach. The traffic was heavy, but we arrived on time.” He shows us an old glove from that time. “We had to steal food? No, we bought it. But I had a stomachache after eating too fast!” We laugh. “What else?” I ask. He thinks about the past: “Even a king can get sick. Health is a gift from God. Use it well. A soldier must be strong, and he must be as clever as a fox.” In the exam week, I remember his words. On the eighth of June, he was born, and now he walks with a stick. “I worked in the steel industry for years,” he adds. We turn on the TV and watch a concert. The music is strong and normal — very nice. His advice is correct. I plant a small tree for him. In the background of the photo is the sea. He has a Japanese friend who speaks English well; as well as that, he can speak French. The test of life is not easy, but his words give me power. What a great man!
readings.translation: 我爷爷九十岁了。他生日那天，我们吃巧克力蛋糕庆祝。他坐在楼梯上给我们讲故事。“我曾在部队当军官。”他说，“有一次，我必须在夜里过河。计划很简单：我们在海滩上插了一面旗。交通很拥挤，但我们按时到达了。”他给我们看当时的一只旧手套。“我们得偷食物吗？不，我们是买的。但吃太快我肚子疼了！”我们笑了。“还有呢？”我问。他回想过去：“连国王也会生病。健康是上帝赐予的礼物，要好好利用。士兵必须强壮，还必须像狐狸一样聪明。”考试周里，我记着他的话。他出生于六月八日，现在拄着拐杖走路。“我在钢铁行业工作多年。”他补充道。我们打开电视看音乐会。音乐强劲又正常——非常好听。他的建议是正确的。我为他种了一棵小树。照片背景是大海。他有一位日语说得很好……不，是英语说得很好的日本朋友；除此之外，他还会说法语。人生的考验不容易，但他的话给了我力量。多么伟大的人！

wordExamples: Our teacher divided the class into eight groups.
“This period, we will do a special activity,” she said.
“Each group must make a poster about a national hero or a famous vehicle.”
My group chose the train.
“Please deal with the facts,” she added.
“Do not copy from the internet. Write in your own handwriting.”
We worked hard and finished on Wednesday.
The result was wonderful: a cool picture of a fast train, with a scarf around the driver’s neck.
We felt great, and my supper that evening tasted even better than usual.

On the fifth day of the week, I wore my new sock to the dining hall, and the cartoon on it made everyone smile; I wanted to remain happy and satisfy my hometown friends, even though we were a kilometre away from home, but I had to be careful not to be late for dinner.
The government built four new schools in our city.

readings.title: The Little Red Fox 小红狐
readings.text: As for the forest, it is quiet in October. A little red fox lives there. Everyone knows him: he is kind but a little poor. One day, two tourists come. “Look, a fox! It is so cute!” They take photos with a camera. The fox is nervous and runs away. Suddenly, he falls into a square hole. “Help!” he cries. “Don’t be afraid,” a boy says. The boy is not stupid; he is clever. He uses a rope and a plank to save the fox. “You are brave,” the fox says. “Please accept my thanks.” The boy smiles, “We should help each other. Compare your life with mine: you are free, but I must study hard every term.” The fox thinks, “It is a pity that I cannot go to school.” At night, the boy turns up the light and reads a book about plants and planets. His homework is basic but important. Outside the window, the fox watches. “The state of nature is beautiful,” the boy says. He notices the fox and waves. They become good friends. The fox brings him grapes and glass bottles. “Don’t eat too much candy; it is bad for your teeth,” the fox says. The boy laughs. Rather than playing games, he likes reading. What a peaceful picture of friendship!

He showed me his tools, and I felt nineteen again, full of dreams and ready for victory.

readings.title: A Night on the Pacific 太平洋之夜
readings.text: At midnight, a lady sits in a tent on the beach. Why? Because she is studying nature. She watches the stars and listens to the sea. “How peaceful!” she thinks. Suddenly, a wind comes up. The tent shakes. “Don’t worry,” she tells herself. “Be able to stay calm, and you will be fine.” She lights a lamp and starts to write in her diary. Her hobby is to collect stones and shells. “Tonight, I found a pink shell,” she writes. “It costs nothing, but it is worth a fortune to me.” She hears a strange sound. A blind old man walks by with a stick. “Excuse me, are you lost?” she asks. “No, I live in the village. My eyes are blind, but my heart can see,” he says. They talk about the east wind and the spring. The lady offers him some tea. “Your kindness is like honey,” he says. At that moment, a fox appears. It is not afraid; it sits down quietly. “The animals trust you,” the old man smiles. The lady laughs. “I cannot afford a hotel, so I camp here. But this is better than any palace!” In the morning, the sun rises over the Pacific. She flies a kite and dances. What a humorous and warm night! Her behaviour shows that kindness has no price.

wordExamples: The doctor told me, “If you have a fever, drink more water and take a rest.”
I thanked him and went home.
On the way, I saw a postman on his bicycle.
“Do you know the way to the northern station?” he asked.
I showed him the direction and watched him ride away.

That evening, I wrote in my diary: “Today I learned to fix my own mistakes. A good student should develop good habits: check the date, read the survey, and never leave questions unanswered. As soon as I grow up, I want to be a helpful visitor to every home, in order to bring warmth to everyone.”

The dead tree stood in the yard, and its sour fruit fell to the ground; fifty years ago my grandfather told me this tale, and now I can retell it; in the tenth grade we learned about the century, and the seventh keyboard on the piano was broken, but my teacher said it was necessary to keep trying until we felt comfortable.
I left my umbrella in the classroom, and the unit test is tomorrow.

readings.title: The Brave Pilot 勇敢的飞行员
readings.text: Be careful! A small plane is flying over the hills. It is a beautiful summer day. The pilot is a young woman named Amy. She wins every race and never gives up. Once, a heavy storm came. The rain beat the windows, and the wind shook the plane. “I am not afraid,” she said to herself. She tried to find a safe place to land. She saw a block of grassland and brought the plane down slowly. The farmers there were surprised. “Are you ok?” they asked. “Yes, but I am hungry,” she laughed. They gave her fruit and fresh milk. Amy told them about her travels. “I have been abroad many times. Each country has its own culture,” she said. A boy asked, “Can I be a pilot like you?” “Yes, if you study hard and practise every day,” she answered. “Don’t be afraid of failure. Laugh at your mistakes and learn from them.” The boy’s eyes were full of pride. In the evening, Amy flew home. Her parents were worried, but she was safe. That night, the whole village talked about the brave pilot. She is a good example for everyone. Through her story, the children learned that courage comes from the heart. What a wonderful woman she is!
readings.translation: 小心！一架小飞机正飞过山丘。那是一个美丽的夏日。飞行员是一位名叫艾米的年轻女士。她赢得每场比赛，从不放弃。有一次，一场大暴雨袭来。雨点敲打着窗户，风吹得飞机摇晃。“我不怕。”她对自己说。她试图寻找安全的着陆点。她看到一片草地，慢慢降落。那里的农民很惊讶：“你没事吧？”“没事，但我饿了。”她笑着说。他们给了她水果和鲜奶。艾米讲起她的旅行：“我多次出国。每个国家都有自己的文化。”一个男孩问：“我能像你一样当飞行员吗？”“能，只要你努力学习、每天练习。”她回答，“不要害怕失败。嘲笑自己的错误，并从中学习。”男孩眼里满是自豪。晚上，艾米飞回家。父母很担心，但她平安无事。那一夜，全村人都在谈论这位勇敢的飞行员。她是大家的好榜样。通过她的故事，孩子们懂得了勇气来自内心。她是多么了不起的女性！

“Wake up early, and do not let the field get dry.”
That afternoon, we had a serious discussion about our dream.
“I want to be a policeman,” Li said.

We all felt the same: an Australian scientist once said, “The world is wide, so keep moving.”

In the fair, I got a good grade, and those shoes fit well; at the end of the day, the rubber ball rolled away, and a certain silence fell; I ordered a lemonade and watched an operation on TV, but I could not communicate my feelings.

readings.title: A Trip to Europe 欧洲之行
readings.text: By the end of June, my dream came true: I went to Europe with my family. We flew to a small country first. The air was fresh, and the streets were clean. We visited an old museum and a famous university. A kind guide told us many stories. “This building is three hundred years old,” she said. “Please don’t touch the paintings; keep them safe.” We walked along a quiet street and saw a market. There were apples, lemons and fresh bread. I bought a small present for my friend. “It is so different from our city,” I said. My mother smiled. “Travel is the best teacher,” she said. In the afternoon, we went to a beach. I collected shells and watched the waves. My father played the piano at the hotel in the evening. “This is my favourite holiday,” I said. We took many photos. On the way home, I thought about the trip. I learned to be patient and brave. I also learned to speak English better. When I returned to school, my classmates wanted to hear everything. I showed them my notebook and told them about the wonderful journey. “You must go and see the world,” I said. What a wonderful experience!
readings.translation: 六月末，我的梦想成真了：我和家人去了欧洲。我们先飞到一个国家。空气清新，街道干净。我们参观了一座古老的博物馆和一所著名的大学。一位友善的导游给我们讲了许多故事。“这座建筑有三百年的历史。”她说，“请不要触摸画作，让它们保持安全。”我们沿着安静的街道走，看到一个市场。那里有苹果、柠檬和新鲜面包。我给朋友买了一份小礼物。“这里和我们的城市太不一样了。”我说。妈妈笑了：“旅行是最好的老师。”下午，我们去了海滩。我捡贝壳、看海浪。晚上，爸爸在酒店弹钢琴。“这是我最喜欢的假期。”我说。我们拍了很多照片。回家的路上，我回想这次旅行。我学会了耐心和勇敢，也学会了更好地说英语。回到学校，同学们想听所有的事。我给他们看笔记本，讲这次奇妙的旅程。“你们一定要去看看世界。”我说。多么美妙的经历！

readings.title: The Dream of a Young Pianist 年轻钢琴家的梦想
readings.text: Do you want to hear a story? A boy named Tom had a dream: to become a pianist. He was not rich, but he was clever and hard-working. Every day he practised the piano for two hours. “Keep on, and your dream will come true,” his mother said. One day, there was a music competition in his town. “This is my chance,” Tom thought. But the piano at home was too old. His teacher said, “You can use the school piano. Practise after class.” Tom worked hard. In the competition, he played a beautiful piece. The audience was quiet; then they clapped loudly. Tom won the first prize! His parents were proud. “I did it!” he shouted. The local newspaper wrote about him. “A star is born,” the report said. But Tom did not stop. “There is always something new to learn,” he said. He decided to help other children learn music. He started a small club. At first, only a few students came. Soon, more and more children joined. His mother smiled, “You are not only a pianist; you are a teacher too.” Tom said, “Music is my language. It can cross borders and touch hearts.” He continued to practise every day. His story spread across the country. What a great example he is!

readings.title: The Kind Nurse 善良的护士
readings.text: A few days ago, I was ill and went to the hospital. A kind nurse looked after me. She was always busy, but she never got angry. “Don’t worry,” she said. “Take this medicine and rest. You will be better soon.” She checked my temperature and gave me some soup. “Eat slowly,” she said. “Food is important for your health.” I watched her work. She helped an old man walk, and she talked to a crying baby. “Why are you so patient?” I asked. She smiled. “Because I love my job. A nurse can save lives,” she said. “When people are in trouble, they need help. I am proud to be useful.” Her words touched my heart. I decided to study hard and become a doctor. “Be kind to everyone,” she told me. “Even a small smile can make a big difference.” That night, I thought about her. She was not famous, but she was a real hero. In our community, she is like a warm sun. I will always remember her. Maybe one day, I can help others like her. At that moment, I understood: the greatest wealth is not money, but love. I want to say to her, “Thank you for your kindness!”

readings.title: The Monkey and the Apple 猴子和苹果
readings.text: He was a clever monkey. One hot June day, he felt very hungry. He saw an apple tree by the road. “I can pick some apples,” he thought. But the tree was too tall. He tried to climb, but he fell down. “Don’t give up!” a voice said. It was a small bird. “Use your brain, not your feet.” The monkey had an idea. He found a long stick and knocked the apples down. “Great!” he shouted. He ate one apple. It was sweet and juicy. “Can I share these with my friends?” he thought. He was not greedy. He took the fruit to his village. The other animals were happy. “Thank you!” they said. The monkey smiled. “Helping others makes me happy,” he said. From that day on, the monkey worked hard every day. He became stronger and smarter. In the autumn, he saved some seeds and planted them. “One day, this will be a big apple forest,” he said. The villagers laughed, “You are too lazy! It takes years.” But the monkey did not care. He believed in his dream. Ten years later, the forest was full of apple trees. Everyone was surprised. “Great things come from small starts,” the monkey said. What a wonderful lesson!

readings.title: The Quiet Street 安静的街道
readings.text: Hi! Let me tell you about my street. It is quiet and clean. There is a small park at the end. Every morning, old people do exercise there. Some play chess; others walk their dogs. I like to draw pictures of the trees. One sunny afternoon, a new family moved in. A boy named Ben was my age. He was shy at first. “Can I play with you?” he asked. “Of course!” I said. We became good friends. We flew kites, read books and talked about our dreams. Ben was good at spelling and math. “How do you learn so fast?” I asked. “I read every day,” he said. He showed me his books. “Reading opens a new world,” he smiled. One day, a stranger came to our street. He looked lost. Ben was brave. “Can I help you, sir?” he asked. The man smiled. “Thank you. I am looking for the post office.” Ben showed him the way. “You are a kind boy,” the man said. That evening, I thought about my friend. He taught me that courage and kindness are important. I decided to be brave like him. Our street is still quiet, but now it is full of friendship. I am happy to have such a good neighbour and friend.

readings.title: A Visit to the Doctor 看医生
readings.text: If you have a headache, what should you do? Ten days ago, my grandfather felt a sharp pain in his leg. We went to see the doctor at once. The doctor was kind and patient. “Don’t worry. It is not dangerous,” he said. He gave my grandfather some medicine and told him to rest. “You need to drink more water and eat more fruit,” he said. On the way home, we walked through the park. The leaves were pale green in July. A group of children were playing with a fan. One child fell down and hurt his knee. My grandfather, who is a real gentleman, helped him up. “Be careful, my boy,” he said. The child smiled and said thank you. That evening, my grandfather felt better. He sat on the sofa and watched TV. “Grandfather, can I bring you some tea?” I asked. “That would be perfect,” he said. He told me about his youth. “I once worked in a factory. I was not famous, but I was proud of my work,” he said. I listened carefully. I learned that health is the greatest treasure. Before bed, I checked the dictionary for the word “patient” and wrote it in my notebook. I want to be a doctor like the kind man we met. This visit changed my life. My grandfather is my hero.

readings.title: The Queen’s Birthday 女王的生日
readings.text: In the middle of winter, a strange thing happened. The queen of a small kingdom lost her favourite ring. Everyone was worried. “We must find it before the party tonight,” said the king. The whole palace became quiet. The queen sat by the window and sighed. “Don’t worry, my dear,” said the king. “Let’s think.” Suddenly, a little girl came in. “Your Majesty, I saw your ring in the garden,” she said. “It was beside a rose.” She brought the ring back. The queen was so happy that she kissed the girl. “What a clever girl! What is your name?” she asked. “Lucy,” the girl said. “I only wanted to help.” That evening, the party was wonderful. There was music, dancing and a big cake. The queen gave Lucy a beautiful dress. “This is your reward,” she said. Lucy smiled. “Helping others is my pleasure,” she said. From that day on, Lucy became a friend of the queen. She often came to the palace to read stories. “A kind heart is more valuable than gold,” the queen often said. The people of the kingdom loved their queen even more. They learned that honesty and kindness can change everything. What a warm story!

readings.title: A Day with Grandma 和奶奶的一天
readings.text: It was a sunny day. I went to visit my grandmother in the village. “Come in, dear!” she said with a big smile. Her small house was warm and full of flowers. We had lunch together: rice, soup and fresh vegetables. “The soup is delicious!” I said. “I made it with love,” she laughed. In the afternoon, we sat in the garden. I told her about my school life. “Physics is difficult, and maths is not easy either,” I said. She nodded. “When I was young, there were no computers. We studied by candlelight,” she said. She showed me an old photo. “This is your grandfather. He was a football player in the north,” she said. “He worked out every day and never gave up.” Her words touched me. “Grandma, can you teach me to cook?” I asked. “Of course!” she said. We made dumplings together. It was great fun! In the evening, we watched the sunset. The sky turned orange and red. “Every day is a gift,” Grandma said. I held her hand and said, “I love you, Grandma.” She smiled and hugged me. On the way home, I thought about her. I want to be as kind as she is. I will visit her again soon.

readings.title: A Letter to My Grandmother 给奶奶的一封信
readings.text: Dear Grandma, How are you? I miss you very much. I am writing to tell you about my new school. It is not far from our house. The classroom is bright, and the playground is big. I have made some good friends. We often play basketball together. My favourite subject is science. Our teacher is very kind. She always explains things carefully. “If you have questions, just ask,” she says. Yesterday, we did an interesting experiment. We put a plant in the dark and watched it grow. “Plants need light,” the teacher said. “This is a simple truth.” I like the library too. There are many books there. I can find out almost everything from them. Whenever I have problems, I read. It helps me think clearly. Grandma, do you remember the old days? You told me stories about the army and the war. I think about your words often. They give me courage. Last week, I joined the school reading club. We meet every Friday afternoon. I want to be a writer one day. I know it is not easy, but I will keep trying. Please take care of yourself. I hope to see you during the holiday. Write back to me when you have time.

readings.title: The Silver Ticket 银票
readings.text: Mr White is a kind old man. He lives alone in a small house. His hobby is fishing. One day, he found a strange envelope on his desk. Inside, there was a silver ticket. “What is this?” he wondered. The ticket said: “Congratulations! You can visit the capital city for free.” Mr White was surprised. “Is this true?” he thought. He decided to go. He packed a small bag and took a train. In the capital, everything was new and exciting. He visited a big museum and a beautiful park. He also saw a football match. “This is wonderful!” he said. On the third day, he met a young man in the hotel. “Excuse me, are you Mr White?” the man asked. “Yes. How do you know my name?” Mr White was surprised. The man smiled. “I am the son of your old friend. You helped my father when he was in trouble. This ticket is my gift to you.” Mr White was deeply moved. “A small kindness can come back to you,” he said. He thanked the young man and returned home. From then on, he continued to help people. “The world is full of love,” he often said. His neighbours all loved him. What a warm story!

readings.title: A Quiet Picnic 安静的野餐
readings.text: My aunt is a doctor. She is always busy, but last weekend she was free. “Let’s have a picnic in the park,” she said. It was a fine day. The sun was warm, and the air was fresh. We took a blanket, some fruit and sandwiches. In the park, we found a quiet place under a big tree. “Listen! Can you hear the birds?” my aunt said. We closed our eyes and listened. It was so peaceful. Then we played games and flew a kite. My little sister ran after the kite and laughed. “Be careful! Don’t fall into the lake!” I shouted. She stopped just in time. In the afternoon, a small earthquake came? No, it was just a big truck passing by. The ground shook a little. “Don’t be afraid,” my aunt said. “Take it easy. It is nothing.” We continued our picnic. My aunt told me about her work. “As a doctor, I must stay calm in any situation,” she said. “I have seen many difficult cases. The most important thing is to help patients.” I admired her. “When I grow up, I want to be like you,” I said. She smiled. “Follow your dream,” she said. In the evening, we went home, tired but happy. It was a simple day, but it was full of love.

readings.title: The Fire and the Rain 大火与雨
readings.text: My brother and I were at home one rainy evening. Suddenly, we saw fire in the kitchen! “Turn off the gas! Call 119!” my brother shouted. I was very nervous, but I tried to stay calm. We ran outside and called the firemen. The fire truck came quickly. The firemen worked hard and put out the fire. “Thank you so much!” my mother said. “You are heroes!” That night, we talked about the accident. “We must be careful with fire,” my father said. “Safety is the most important thing.” He taught us how to use a fire blanket and how to escape. I listened carefully. “Remember: stay low and cover your mouth,” he said. The next day, we cleaned the kitchen. My brother found a broken pan. “This caused the fire,” he said. We threw it away. My mother hugged us. “I am proud of you,” she said. “You were brave and calm.” That experience changed us. We learned to check the gas before bed and never to play with matches. Fire is useful, but it is also dangerous. We should always respect it. Now our family is safer and happier. Sometimes, accidents teach us the most important lessons.

readings.title: The Deaf Pianist 失聪的钢琴家
readings.text: No one believed that a deaf boy could become a great musician. But Tony did. When he was a child, an illness took away his hearing. “Your ears are closed, but your heart is open,” his mother said. Tony did not give up. He watched people play the piano and felt the music with his hands. “I can feel the sound in my body,” he said. He practised for hours every day. Sometimes he was angry and sad, but he always continued. One day, a famous teacher heard about him. “This boy has a special talent,” the teacher said. “I will teach him.” Tony worked harder than ever. At the age of eighteen, he played at a big concert. The audience cried with joy. “How can he play so well?” people asked. Tony smiled. “Music is not only for ears. It is for the heart,” he said. His story spread quickly. Many young people wanted to meet him. “If Tony can do it, we can do it too!” they said. Tony became famous all over the world. But he stayed modest. “I am not special. I just never stopped,” he said. He often said, “Never let a difficulty stop your dream. The only real failure is giving up.” His courage touched millions of hearts. What a true hero!

readings.title: A Lesson from the Factory 工厂里的一课
readings.text: Of course, not all lessons come from books. Last summer, I worked in a small factory for a week. My job was to help pack boxes. It was hard work. “Be careful! These boxes are heavy,” said the manager. I worked from morning to night. My hands were tired, but I did not complain. On the third day, I made a mistake. I put the wrong label on a box. “Don’t worry,” said an old worker. “Everyone makes mistakes. The important thing is to learn from them.” He showed me how to do the job well. “You are young. Study hard and you will have a better future,” he said. His words made me think. At the end of the week, the manager gave me my pay. “You did a good job,” he said. “Come back anytime.” I was happy. I bought a gift for my mother and some books for myself. That summer, I learned the value of work. Money does not come easily. I also learned to respect every worker. “Every job is important,” I thought. Now I study harder than before. I want to be a useful person to society. This experience will stay in my heart forever.

readings.title: A Snowy Adventure 雪中历险
readings.text: OK, let me tell you about our winter adventure. It snowed heavily last Friday. Our school was closed, so we stayed home. “Let’s build a snowman!” my sister said. We went outside and played in the snow. We made a big snowman with a carrot nose and a funny hat. “It looks alive!” I laughed. Suddenly, we saw a small bird in the snow. It could not fly. “It is too cold. Let’s help it,” I said. We took the bird home and put it near the fire. My mother gave it some water and rice. After an hour, the bird felt better. It flew around the room and sat on my shoulder. “What a lovely bird!” my sister said. We named it Snowy. The next morning, the sun came out. We opened the window, and Snowy flew away. “Goodbye, Snowy! Come back soon!” we shouted. My mother smiled. “You have kind hearts,” she said. That evening, we drew a picture of the snowman and the bird. We wrote a poem about our adventure. “This is the best winter I have ever had,” I said. We learned that even a small act of kindness can make the world warmer. I will never forget that snowy day.
